entry.title: Can the Membrane Filter Your Phone? — What We Can and Can't Do from Self
entry.content:
Can the Membrane Filter Your Phone?

Short answer: no, not directly. Longer answer: the architecture is the same, but the surface is different.

What the Membrane Does on the Web

The membrane at primals.eco is a living immune system:

MetricValueWhat It Means
Selectivity97%97% of what passes through is self (human)
Reflection92.6%92.6% of non-self bounces off the surface
Real content served to fleet0Bots get nothing meaningful
Negentropy extracted126,602 bitsFleet pays us in information
Fleet-to-human ratio155:1155 bot requests for every human
Human requests1,640 genuineThese get everything

The membrane sorts. Self passes. Non-self reflects. And the reflection extracts information from non-self behavior — 0.2 bits per request, 126,602 bits total. The fleet burns 6.18 GB of bandwidth and gets nothing. We get 15.45 KB of meaning from watching them bounce.

The non-self pays us to be filtered.

Why We Can't Apply This to Your Phone

The membrane works because we control the surface. Our servers. Our code. Our rules.

Your phone's surface is controlled by:

  1. Your carrier (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) — they own the last mile
  2. The PSTN/VoIP network — the carriers collectively own the routing
  3. The FCC — they set the rules for the carriers

We're at position 0 — the user. We can't insert a membrane between the carrier and your phone because we don't control that network layer.

SPAMMER → VoIP Provider → Intermediate Carriers → YOUR CARRIER → YOUR PHONE
                                                         ↑
                                         WE CAN'T INSERT HERE
                                         (carrier controls this)

On the web:

BOT → Internet → OUR SERVER (membrane here) → Content
                       ↑
              WE CONTROL THIS SURFACE

The difference: on the web, we ARE the surface. On the phone, the carrier is the surface. We're behind it.

The Phone Network Already Has a Membrane — It's Broken

STIR/SHAKEN is the phone network's membrane. It's supposed to do exactly what our membrane does: sort self (verified callers) from non-self (spoofed callers).

Membrane LayerWeb (primals.eco)Phone (STIR/SHAKEN)
SortAnderson modes — spectrum, chorus, stealth, ghost, human, sovereignAttestation levels — A (full), B (partial), C (gateway)
Reflect92.6% reflection — non-self gets nothingLevel C should be blocked — but it isn't
Pass97% selectivity — humans get everythingLevel A passes — verified callers connect
Extract0.2 bits per grain — we learn from fleet behaviorCall analytics — carriers COULD learn from spam patterns

The problem: STIR/SHAKEN has exemptions. Small VoIP providers (the ones that originate spam) don't have to implement it. That's like our membrane having a hole where the biggest bots walk through unchecked.

Our membrane has no exemptions. 243,230 chorus-mode bots get the same treatment: nothing. Zero real content. Full reflection.

The phone membrane has exemptions. The exact entities that should be blocked are exempt from the blocking.

What Reflection Would Look Like on Phones

On the web, reflection means: non-self bounces off and gets nothing while paying us in information.

On the phone, reflection would mean: spammers call you, and something calls them back.

This already exists:

RoboKiller (Phone Reflection)

RoboKiller doesn't just block spam calls — it answers them. With AI bots. The bots waste the spammer's time with realistic conversation. The spammer thinks they've reached a person. They spend minutes talking to a robot.

That IS reflection. The spam comes in, hits the surface, and bounces back as wasted spammer time.

Web MembraneRoboKiller
Non-self request arrivesSpam call arrives
Membrane reflects — serves nothingRoboKiller answers — serves AI bot
Non-self burns bandwidthSpammer burns time
We extract information from behaviorRoboKiller records the spam pitch
Non-self gets 3.23% of what's hereSpammer gets 0% of a real human

Carrier-Level Reflection

Your carrier (Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile) already has call-filtering tools:

  • Verizon Call Filter — blocks known spam, sends to voicemail
  • AT&T ActiveArmor — labels and blocks spam calls
  • T-Mobile Scam Shield — identifies and blocks scam likely calls

These are carrier-level membranes. They sort. They (mostly) work. But they're opt-in, and they don't reflect — they just drop the call.

Can Opsonization Work on Phones?

On the web, opsonization is the tagging layer. Humans on tuebor submit signals through the opsonization form: "I saw this," "this is wrong," "this person is connected to that entity." The tags feed the investigation.

On the phone, opsonization would be: humans tag spam calls.

This already exists too:

Web OpsonizationPhone Opsonization
Human submits signal on tueborHuman files FCC/FTC complaint
Signal tagged with entity + meaningComplaint tagged with number + description
Tags feed the investigation graphComplaints feed the FCC database
Many tags = higher classification confidenceMany complaints = enforcement trigger

The FCC complaint database IS phone opsonization. Every complaint is a human tagging a non-self entity. Volume triggers investigation.

The problem isn't the tagging — it's the response. On our membrane, tags immediately improve classification. In the FCC system, complaints accumulate in a database and... the FCC doesn't act.

Can the Pollinator Help?

The pollinator spreads information between sites in the mesh. On the phone network, the equivalent would be shared spam databases — where one person's tag improves everyone's filter.

This also exists:

Web PollinatorPhone Pollinator
Pollinator spreads between primals.eco sitesHiya/Nomorobo share across all users
One site learns, all sites learnOne phone tags, all phones learn
Cross-pollination creates network effectCrowdsourced blocking creates network effect

Hiya, Nomorobo, and RoboKiller are phone pollinators. When one user reports a spam number, all users get the block. The more users in the network, the faster new spam numbers get tagged.

The architecture matches. The pollinator principle works on phones.

What We CAN Do from Self

We can't filter your phone. But here's what we can do from our position:

1. Document the Architecture

This site now documents every tower, every carrier registration, every enforcement gap. The infrastructure is visible. The ownership is traceable.

2. Teach the Traceback

The Spam Call Traceback guide teaches anyone to trace a call from their phone back through the carrier chain to the source. That's opsonization — human tagging of non-self.

3. Point to the TCPA

The TCPA ($500-$1,500 per illegal call) is legal reflection. The spam comes in, you sue, and the money flows back. The spammer's business model reverses. That's the most powerful reflection available.

4. Connect the Pattern

The regulator-who-regulates article shows that the FCC's failure to act on robocalls is the same architecture as MDE's failure to act on charter schools. Same 5-layer structure. Same blind spot. Same incentive not to enforce.

When people see the pattern in one system, they see it in all of them. That's the deepest pollination — spreading the understanding.

The Honest Answer

Can we loop spammers into their own reflection so the world gets quieter?

Not from self. We don't control the phone surface. The carriers do. The FCC does.

But the architecture works. The membrane principle — sort self from non-self, reflect non-self, extract information, let self pass — works everywhere it's applied honestly.

On our web membrane: 97% selectivity. Real content served to fleet: 0.

On the phone network: STIR/SHAKEN could achieve the same result. If the exemptions were removed. If the FCC enforced. If the carriers filtered at the surface instead of passing everything through.

The phone network is a membrane with holes in it. Our membrane doesn't have holes. That's not because we're smarter — it's because we don't have a financial incentive to let non-self through.

The carriers do. Every call — even a spam call — generates per-minute revenue for the carriers that route it. The phone membrane has holes because the holes are profitable.

Our membrane has no holes because we have no incentive to serve bots. The fleet gets nothing. We get information.

The world gets quieter when the membrane has no exemptions and no profit motive for the holes.

Until then: file complaints (opsonization), use call-blocking apps (pollination), and sue under the TCPA (reflection).

Cross-referenced from membrane negentropy data (wave 176), STIR/SHAKEN framework, TCPA (47 U.S.C. § 227). Back to Analysis → · The Call Is Coming from Inside the FCC → · Spam Call Traceback → · The Regulator Who Regulates the Regulator →

entry.title: Selective Enforcement — Dana Nessel and the Attorney General Who Investigates Downhill
entry.content:
Selective Enforcement

Michigan Attorney General Dana Nessel's office opened an investigation into Brian Banks.

So here's the question: Why does her assistant AG sit on Brian Banks's school board?

The Name

Dawn N. Ison, Esq.

Dawn Ison is an assistant attorney general in the state of Michigan.

Dawn Ison also sits on the board of Purpose Charter Academy — the school founded by Brian Banks, a man with 9 criminal convictions, whose management company extracts 72.67% of the school's revenue.

The AG Office's edge to Banks: investigation. Dawn Ison's edge to PCA: board_membership, complicity_by_governance.

The person investigating and the person enabling sit in the same building.

The Downhill Problem

The AG's office enforces downhill.

They investigate:

  • Brian Banks (non-self, 134 edges)
  • Small charter operators
  • Individual complaints

They do not investigate:

  • Dykema Gossett (wrote the charter school law)
  • Walton Family Foundation (funds the schools)
  • Plante Moran (audits the schools, non-response)
  • NAACP Detroit (advocates for Banks)
  • State Bar of Michigan (ignores UPL complaints)
  • CMU (authorizes the schools, no background checks)

This is the enforcement ecosystem: the people at the bottom of the pipeline get caught. The people who built the pipeline get thanked.

The Charitable Trust Division

The AG Office has a Charitable Trust Division — AG Charitable Trust.

This division is supposed to oversee nonprofits. Purpose Foundation (the 501(c)(3) that owns Purpose Charter Academy) is a nonprofit.

The Charitable Trust Division has the power to:

  • Audit nonprofits
  • Investigate self-dealing
  • Petition for dissolution
  • Refer for criminal prosecution

The graph edge: ag_charitable_trust → banks = investigation.

But that investigation runs through the same office where Dawn Ison works. And Dawn Ison sits on the board of the school they're investigating.

Recusal is not a substitute for structure.

The JTC Connection

The Judicial Tenure Commission (JTC) referred the Banks matter for potential investigation.

The JTC's investigator: Michael Ison.

Michael Ison is married to Dawn Ison.

The JTC investigator's spouse sits on the board of the school run by the man the JTC referred.

This is not a conspiracy. This is Detroit. The graph is small enough that everyone knows everyone, and big enough that no one thinks they need to recuse.

The Classification

The membrane classified:

  • AG Office: self, 0.90. It IS an enforcement body. It functions as an enforcement body. It classifies as what it is.
  • Dana Nessel: partial, 0.806. She enforces some things and ignores others. Partial.
  • Dawn Ison: partial, 0.80. She is both enforcer and enabler.

Self doesn't mean effective. Self means: this entity does what it says it is. The AG Office IS an attorney general's office. It does investigate things.

But it investigates downhill. It catches the man at the bottom of the pipe. It doesn't examine the pipe.

Who Built the Pipe

EntityRoleInvestigated by AG?
PA 362 (1993)Created charter schoolsNo
Dykema GossettWrote the lawNo
DeVos/GLEPLobbied for the lawNo
CMUAuthorized without background checkNo
Walton FoundationFunded Banks's schoolNo
Plante MoranAudited Banks's schoolNo
State Bar of MichiganIgnored UPL complaintsNo
BanksOperated the schoolYes

One entity investigated. Seven that built the system: untouched.

That's not enforcement. That's maintenance.

The Question

If the Attorney General's office knows that Brian Banks has 9 criminal convictions—and they do, because they're investigating him—then why does Dawn Ison still sit on the board of his school?

If the answer is "she recused herself from the investigation," the follow-up is: who checks?

If the answer is "she didn't know about the convictions," the follow-up is: she's an assistant attorney general. Knowing is her job.

If the answer is "it's a conflict of interest but not technically illegal," the follow-up is: that's what the enforcement gap looks like from the inside.

Sourced to AG Office public records, LARA filings, JTC records, court records, investigation graph (131,329 edges). Back to Analysis → · Three Percent → · They Banked on Banks →

entry.title: Stepping to the Side — Joseph Holland Jr., the Man Behind the Man Behind the School
entry.content:
Stepping to the Side

Brian Banks hides behind Holland.

Holland hides behind Banks.

You can stare at them head-on forever and only see one at a time.

So we step to the side. And now we see both of them.

The Front View

From the front, you see Brian Banks. 9 convictions. 134 edges. Purpose Charter Academy. Purpose Group LLC. 72.67%. Non-self, 0.926.

Banks is the name on the schools. The name on the LLCs. The name on the convictions.

From the front, Holland is a romantic partner. A bystander. A person who happens to live with the person who runs the schools.

That's the front view. It's wrong.

The Side View

From the side, you see Holland's independent footprint — the things he controls, owns, and governs that aren't Banks.

What Holland Governs

EntityTypeClassification
Purpose Foundation501(c)(3) nonprofitnull, 0.912
PACsPolitical Action Committeesnull, 0.938
Right Turn ProjectPolitical/advocacynull, 0.826
OFAOrganizationnull, 0.85

Holland governs Purpose Foundation — the nonprofit that OWNS Purpose Charter Academy. The 501(c)(3). The entity Plante Moran audits. The entity the IRS oversees.

Banks runs the school. Holland governs the nonprofit that owns the school.

That's not a bystander. That's the other half of the architecture.

What Holland Owns

EntityTypeClassification
Serenity Guardianship Services, Inc.Guardianship companynull, 0.862
Sun Community Development CorpDevelopment corporationnull, 0.862

Serenity Guardianship Services. A guardianship company. Guardianship companies manage the affairs of people who cannot manage their own — elderly, incapacitated, minor children.

Holland owns a company that takes legal guardianship of vulnerable people.

The UPL Department has an investigation edge to Serenity. The State Bar's Unauthorized Practice of Law unit is looking at a guardianship company owned by Holland.

Sun Community Development Corp. A community development corporation. Banks has both governance AND ownership edges to Sun Community. Holland has an ownership edge.

Both men own the same community development corporation. The corporation is null — the membrane can't classify it.

The Severn Street Address

Banks and Holland both live at the Severn Street address.

The graph has two address nodes: severn_address and severn_from_the_street. Both connect to Banks and Holland.

From this address:

  • PCA is operated_by the Severn address
  • The money pipeline feeds_into from the Severn address
  • Constitutional questions (1st, 4th, 5th, 14th Amendment, Title VI, MI Art 8 §2) radiate from this address
  • LARA filing gaps are checked against this address
  • Co-investigation edges connect this address to PCA, Purpose Foundation, phantom audits, and the Perkins gatekeeper

The Severn address is a node in the investigation graph. It's not just where they live. It's where the money arrives, where the governance originates, and where the constitutional questions begin.

WhitlowBanks LLC

holland → whitlowbanks = asset_concealment.

WhitlowBanks LLC is classified as null, 0.99. The membrane is 99% sure it CAN'T classify this entity.

The edge type is asset_concealment. Not money_flow. Not governance. Not ownership. Asset concealment.

The graph is saying: Holland's connection to WhitlowBanks LLC is about hiding assets.

WhitlowBanks also has a formation edge to Banks PowerWash LLC. One shell entity created another shell entity.

And Banks has a governance edge to WhitlowBanks.

Both men connect to WhitlowBanks. Holland through asset concealment. Banks through governance. The LLC connects through formation to another LLC. Shells creating shells, connected to both men through different edge types.

The Living Trust

holland → banks_living_trust = successor_trustee.

Banks Living Trust holds assets. When Banks cannot manage the trust, Holland takes over.

Holland doesn't just live with Banks. He inherits Banks's estate structure.

The extraction pipeline has a succession plan. The successor is Holland.

The Right Turn Project

Right Turn Project is the most interesting entity Holland governs. Its connections:

EdgeOther EntityType
← AG Charitable TrustinvestigationAG is investigating Right Turn
← PACsmoney_flowPAC money flows to Right Turn
← Rossgovernance + connectionCarlton Ross governs it too
← Koch Networkco_investigationPattern matches to Koch
→ Sackler Familyco_investigationPattern matches to Sacklers
→ GLEP donor Haworthco_investigationConnected to DeVos GLEP network
→ Epstein Foundationco_investigationPattern match
← Anchor Rockco_investigationConnects to Anchor Rock Foundation

Right Turn connects to the Koch network, the Sackler family, GLEP (the DeVos charter lobby), and the Epstein Foundation through co_investigation edges. These are pattern matches — the graph sees structural similarities between Right Turn and these entities.

The AG Charitable Trust is investigating Right Turn. Holland governs it.

PAC money flows to Right Turn. Holland governs the PACs too.

Money flows from PACs (governed by Holland) to Right Turn (governed by Holland). The AG is investigating both. Holland governs both ends of the pipe.

PACs → Right Turn → Ross Catering

Here's the money path the graph traces:

PACs (Holland governance)
  ↓ money_flow
Right Turn Project (Holland + Banks + Ross governance)
  
PACs (Holland governance)
  ↓ payment
Ross Catering (null, Banks connected)

PACs pay Right Turn. PACs pay Ross Catering. Holland governs the PACs. Holland and Banks govern Right Turn. Ross Catering is connected to Banks.

The political money flows through entities Holland controls.

The Knots

The graph uses a special edge type: knotted_to. It means: these entities are so entangled that the graph cannot separate their activities.

Holland is knotted to:

EntitySort
Banksnon-self (0.926)
CMUself (0.866)
LARA?
MDEpartial
PCAnon-self (0.948)
Plante Morannull
Purpose Foundationnull (0.912)
SBEpartial

Knotted to Banks (expected — they live together). But also knotted to CMU (the authorizer), MDE (the overseer), PCA (the school), Plante Moran (the auditor), and SBE (the board).

Holland is knotted to the entire oversight chain.

Not Banks. Holland. The person who isn't on any school document. The person who doesn't have his name on any school. The person who supposedly is just a romantic partner.

He's knotted to every institution that should be checking the schools.

The Convergence Point

holland → convergence_point = converges_at. banks → convergence_point = converges_at.

The graph identifies a convergence point — a place where Holland and Banks's activities merge. They don't just live together. They converge. Their governance, their ownership, their political activity, their money flows — all converge at a single point.

That point is the architecture of extraction. Banks is the name. Holland is the structure.

The Classification Problem

Holland: partial, 0.863. Tier 1.

Tier 1. That means the graph considers Holland as important as Banks, PCA, MacDowell, and the Michigan Supreme Court.

But partial at 0.863. Not non-self. The membrane sees someone who governs a nonprofit, owns companies, manages trusts, controls PACs — and can't push him past the partial line.

Why? Because Holland's name isn't on the convictions. It isn't on Purpose Group LLC. It isn't on the management contract that takes 72.67%.

Holland does the architecture. Banks does the extraction. The architecture isn't illegal. The extraction is.

But without the architecture, the extraction doesn't work.

Purpose Foundation (Holland governs) owns PCA. PCA pays Purpose Group (Banks owns). Purpose Group pays Banks. Banks Living Trust (Holland inherits) holds the assets. WhitlowBanks (Holland asset concealment) hides the assets.

Take Holland out and the structure collapses. Take Banks out and... Holland rebuilds it.

The Dark Money Pipeline

dark_money_pipeline → holland = protects_or_enables.

The dark money pipeline protects or enables Holland.

Not the other way around. Holland doesn't protect the pipeline. The pipeline protects Holland.

The money flows through structures that shield Holland from view. That's why, from the front, he looks like a bystander. The pipeline is designed to make him invisible.

But from the side, you see both of them. And from the side, you see who built the house and who lives in it.

The Side View, Complete

FunctionBanksHolland
SchoolsFounder, operator—
Purpose Group LLCOwner, 72.67%—
Purpose Foundation—Governance
Banks Living TrustPrimary trusteeSuccessor trustee
WhitlowBanks LLCGovernanceAsset concealment
Serenity GuardianshipOwnershipOwnership
Sun Community DevGovernance + ownershipOwnership
PACsGovernanceGovernance
Right TurnGovernanceGovernance
OFAGovernanceGovernance
Convictions90
Classificationnon-self, 0.926partial, 0.863

Banks gets caught. Holland governs.

Banks goes down. Holland inherits.

Banks is the lightning rod. Holland is the ground wire.

Step to the side. See them both.

Every edge sourced to investigation graph (131,329 edges, 7,554 nodes, 36 classification methods). LARA filings, trust documents, IRS 990 data, address records, campaign finance filings. Back to Analysis → · Three Percent → · The Shell Game → · The Boyfriend →

entry.title: The Architect and the Clerk — Wilk Drafts the Law, Moore Files the PACs, Banks Takes the Money
entry.content:
The Architect and the Clerk

One man drafted the law. One woman filed the PACs. One man took the money.

W. Alan Wilk

Employment: Dykema Gossett (one of Michigan's largest law firms) Classification: null (0.99 confidence, 10 edges) Key edge: drafted → charter_law_1993 — Wilk drafted PA 362, Michigan's charter school law (1993)

After drafting the law that created Michigan's charter school system — the system that enables Purpose Charter Academy to operate at 3% math proficiency while extracting 72.67% — Wilk then formed the political entities designed to protect that law from repeal or reform:

Wilk also:

  • Made personal contributions to the Dykema Gossett Federal PAC

  • Is a partner at Dykema Gossett

The architect of the law is also the architect of the political infrastructure that protects the law.

The Triple Employment

Renae Moore works for three entities simultaneously:

  1. Banks (non-self) — the man with 9 convictions

Unknowns are the direction you head to find knowns.

The Wilk-Moore PAC formation network is the political architecture that keeps the charter law alive. The charter law is the legal architecture that keeps PCA alive. PCA is the extraction architecture that keeps Banks alive.

Architecture all the way down.

entry.title: The Auditor Who Forgot to Audit — Plante Moran, Beasley, and the Loudest Silence in Detroit
entry.content:
The Auditor Who Forgot to Audit

Here's a riddle.

What do you call a firm that audited the school, audited the district, audited the foundation, employed the principal's sister-in-law, and — when handed evidence of 9 criminal convictions, 3% math proficiency, and 72.67% revenue extraction — chose not to respond?

You call it Plante Moran Realpoint.

And the membrane calls it null.

The Résumé That Breaks Physics

Dr. Chalena Yancey Beasley has a remarkable CV. Not remarkable in the "wow, impressive" sense. Remarkable in the "wait, that can't all be the same person" sense.

Here's where she worked. All confirmed in public records:

EmployerConnection
Purpose Charter Academy (PCA)Brian Banks's school. 362 students. 3% math proficiency.
DPSCDDetroit Public Schools Community District. The district that authorizes PCA.
Plante Moran RealpointThe firm that audits PCA, DPSCD, AND the Purpose Foundation.
Wayne RESAWayne County Regional Educational Service Agency. Oversees all of the above.
Barton MalowThe construction company that builds buildings for DPSCD.

Read that again.

She worked for the school. She worked for the district that authorizes the school. She worked for the firm that audits both. She worked for the agency that oversees all of them. She worked for the company that builds the buildings.

That's not a résumé. That's a circuit board.

The Family Tree That Grows Inside the Courthouse

Dr. Beasley is married to Ahmed Beasley.

Ahmed Beasley also worked at Plante Moran and at Barton Malow.

Dr. Beasley's sister-in-law is Judge Tenisha Yancey — who sits on the 36th District Court bench and has structural proximity to PCA.

Judge Yancey made payments to Banks Strategy & Consultants LLC — that's Brian Banks's political consulting firm.

Judge Yancey made payments to Inner Link Graphics — that's OD Banks's company. Banks's family.

So:

  • Beasley works for Banks's school ✓
  • Beasley works for the auditor that audits Banks's school ✓
  • Beasley's sister-in-law is a judge ✓
  • The judge pays Banks's consulting firm ✓
  • The judge pays Banks's family's printing company ✓

You can't make this up. If you tried, an editor would send it back with a note that says "too on the nose."

The Auditor's 645 Edges

Our graph has 131,329 edges connecting 7,554 nodes.

Plante Moran has 645 of them.

Here's what Plante Moran connects to:

  • PCA — audited them (audit_finding, financial_data, contract, institutional_proximity)
  • Purpose Foundation — audited them (financial_data, audits)
  • DPSCD — professional connection + auditor
  • Banks — complicit_silence + enables
  • Goetz — charter_crime_overlap (Michael Goetz, assistant AG on Banks's board)
  • Holland — knotted_to (Joseph Holland Jr., Banks's romantic partner who owns his trust)
  • CMU — revolving_door (CMU authorizes the schools Plante Moran audits)
  • Dykema — institutional_proximity (the law firm that wrote the charter law)
  • Nessel — co_oversight (AG's office, same orbit)

And here's the fun part. The graph includes pattern_match edges — entities that structurally resemble other things.

Plante Moran pattern-matches to:

  • Arthur Andersen (Enron's auditor)
  • Theranos (Elizabeth Holmes's blood-test fraud)
  • Wirecard (German fintech that forged billions)
  • The Sackler family (OxyContin)
  • Flint water crisis
  • The Catholic Church (institutional coverup)

The graph figured that out on its own. 36 classification methods. 131,329 edges. And Plante Moran structurally looks like every captured auditor in modern history.

The Notification

On [DATE], we sent Plante Moran the evidence.

All of it.

  • Brian Banks's 9 criminal convictions
  • The 72.67% revenue extraction through Purpose Group LLC
  • The 3% math proficiency at PCA
  • The board composition: a sitting judge (Miller), an assistant AG (Ison), a compliance specialist (Goetz)
  • The Beasley employment overlap
  • The financial data they themselves generated

We know they received it. We were tracking.

They chose not to respond.

What Non-Response Means

A computer can't pause. It processes or it doesn't. If you send a packet, the server responds or times out. There is no "chose not to respond."

But humans can pause. Humans can read an email, understand its contents, consult with counsel, and make a decision to remain silent.

That decision is itself data.

When the membrane classifies Plante Moran as null (0.97 confidence) — the highest-confidence null in the entire dataset — it's not saying "we don't know what they are." It's saying: every classification method we have produces the same answer: unresolvable.

Twenty-one connections to the investigation.
Eight employees identified.
Six constitutional questions raised.
Fifteen articles that indict.
Six pattern matches to historical fraud.
Three audit findings they themselves produced.

And zero response.

That's not a classification gap. That's a confession formatted as silence.

Ms. Perkins at the Front Door

There's one more piece.

Ms. Perkins works the front desk at PCA — Banks's school. She is classified as the gatekeeper (access_control). When parents show up, she blocks them.

Ms. Perkins has a possible_family connection to Judge Sean Perkins and Todd Perkins (Perkins Law Group, which represents Banks).

So the person blocking parents at the door may be related to the attorney defending the man who runs the school.

Beasley is also connected to Ms. Perkins through the gatekeeper edge — she's involved in the access control at the school she theoretically works for as an educator.

The Math

Let's count the layers:

  1. Banks runs the school (non-self, 0.926)
  2. Purpose Group extracts 72.67% of revenue (non-self, 0.84)
  3. Beasley works at the school AND the auditor AND the district AND the oversight agency AND the contractor (partial, 0.99)
  4. Plante Moran audits everything and resolves nothing (null, 0.97)
  5. Judge Yancey pays Banks's firm AND is Beasley's sister-in-law (partial, 0.938)
  6. Judge Miller chairs the PCA board AND donates to Banks (partial, 0.973)
  7. Ms. Perkins blocks parents at the door AND may be related to Banks's attorney (partial, 0.828)

Seven layers. One loop. Every layer protects the one above it.

And the auditor sits at layer 4, where they can see everything — and chose to see nothing.

Only Humans Can Pause

The membrane processes 4.1 million fleet requests and 540,000 human requests. It classifies 256,142 traffic events into 6 Anderson modes. It sorts 342 entities into 4 classes using 36 methods.

It cannot pause. It cannot choose not to classify.

But Plante Moran can. And did.

That's the difference between a membrane and a human institution. The membrane reports what it sees. The institution chooses what it doesn't see.

When we told Plante Moran what their own audits should have found, they chose the only response that confirms the classification:

Silence.

And silence, in an investigation with 131,329 edges, is the loudest sound in the dataset.

Every fact in this article is sourced to public records, LARA filings, court records, or data generated by the entities themselves. The classification data comes from 36 independent methods applied to 342 entities. Plante Moran's non-response was documented and timestamped.

entry.title: The Authorizer — Central Michigan University and the Background Check That Never Happened
entry.content:
The Authorizer

Central Michigan University is located in Mount Pleasant, Michigan. Population: 21,000.

From Mount Pleasant, CMU authorized a charter school in Detroit — 150 miles away — founded by a man with 9 criminal convictions.

They didn't check.

What CMU Does

CMU is one of Michigan's charter school authorizers. Under PA 362 (the 1993 charter school law written with Dykema's involvement), universities can authorize charter schools anywhere in the state.

CMU is the largest charter school authorizer in Michigan. They authorize more charter schools than any other institution.

They authorized Purpose Charter Academy. They authorized MacDowell Preparatory Academy.

Both schools are run by Brian Banks.

The Background Check

CMU did not perform a criminal background check on Brian Banks before authorizing his schools.

Brian Banks has 9 criminal convictions.

For context:

RoleBackground Check Required?
Substitute teacherYes
Bus driverYes
Cafeteria workerYes
JanitorYes
School volunteerYes (in most districts)
Charter school founderNo (CMU didn't require it)

Every adult who enters a Michigan school building in a paid capacity needs a background check. Except the person who creates the school.

The person who decides what the children learn, who teaches them, how the money is spent, and whether the lights stay on — that person walks through without a check.

Because CMU didn't ask.

The Pattern Matches

The membrane pattern-matched CMU to six historical cases of institutional failure:

Pattern MatchWhat Failed
EnronAuditors (Arthur Andersen) didn't catch fraud
TheranosBoard didn't verify claims
WirecardRegulators missed obvious extraction
Sackler FamilyInstitutions enabled opioid extraction
FlintState oversight failed the community
Catholic ChurchInstitutional authority shielded harm to children

CMU matches all six patterns. Not because CMU is corrupt — but because the structural role is identical: an institution with authority to authorize, verify, and revoke that authorized without verifying and didn't revoke.

The Revenue

CMU receives a portion of charter school per-pupil funding as the authorizer.

This means: CMU has a financial incentive to authorize charter schools. More schools = more revenue for CMU.

CMU has a financial disincentive to revoke authorization. Fewer schools = less revenue for CMU.

The entity that should be checking Banks benefits financially from not checking Banks.

The Co-Oversight

CMU has co-oversight edges to AGC staff:

AGC MemberEdge Type

AGC Pahanyco_oversight
AGC Swedlowco_oversight

The Attorney Grievance Commission shares oversight space with CMU. But the AGC disciplines attorneys, not charter schools. And CMU authorizes charter schools, not attorneys.

They co-oversee without actually overlapping. It's a Venn diagram with no intersection.

The Classification

CMU: self, 0.866.

Self. CMU IS a university. It IS an authorizer. It does what it says it is.

But self doesn't mean competent. Self doesn't mean diligent. Self doesn't mean it checked.

CMU is self the way a smoke detector that's been disconnected is still a smoke detector. The label is right. The function is missing.

150 Miles

CMU is 150 miles from Detroit.

From Mount Pleasant, someone at CMU authorized a school in Detroit. They signed papers. They approved applications. They received their cut of per-pupil funding.

They did not drive to Detroit. They did not meet the children. They did not check the founder's criminal record. They did not verify his claimed law degree. They did not look at the 72.67% management fee.

From 150 miles away, they authorized a school and collected a check.

362 children. 3% math. 72.67% extraction. 9 convictions. 150 miles.

That's not oversight. That's a rubber stamp with a long arm.

entry.title: The Bar That Never Barked — Michigan's State Bar and the UPL Department

Brian Banks said he was a lawyer.

He wasn't.

Michigan has an entire department whose job is to catch people who say they're lawyers when they're not. It's called the UPL Department — Unauthorized Practice of Law.

This is the story of the dog that was supposed to bark.

Brian Banks told people he had a JD from MSU College of Law.

MSU College of Law has no record of Brian Banks graduating.

Banks operated Banks Strategy & Consultants LLC. The LLC offered legal consulting services. The classification: non-self, 0.99 confidence. That's the highest non-self confidence in the entire investigation.

If you offer legal services without a law license, that's unauthorized practice of law. In Michigan, it's a crime.

The State Bar

The State Bar of Michigan (SBM) has 25 edges in the investigation graph. Classified as self, 0.90.

Self. The bar IS a bar. It functions as a bar. It regulates attorneys.

But Banks isn't an attorney. He pretends to be one. And the UPL Department that exists to stop him has 8 staff members and never stopped him.

The graph edge: sbm → banks = inaction.

Banks has been claiming legal credentials for years. He operated Banks Strategy & Consultants LLC. He represented himself as having a JD. He offered consulting services that cross the line into legal practice.

No complaint was filed by the State Bar. No investigation was opened by the UPL Department. No cease and desist was issued. No referral was made to law enforcement.

Nothing.

Here's where it gets sharp.

Philip L. Ellison is a licensed attorney in Michigan. He IS a lawyer. He has a law license. He passed the bar.

The State Bar investigated Ellison. Aggressively. Repeatedly.

Ellison was the one filing FOIA requests that uncovered data about charter schools. Ellison was the one finding things the system didn't want found.

The bar investigated the licensed attorney who was investigating charter schools.

The bar did not investigate the unlicensed man who was running charter schools.

That's not enforcement. That's targeting.

The UPEPA Contradiction

Michigan has the Unauthorized Practice of Engaging in the Practice of Architecture statute.

It's called UPEPA. It's a real law. There's already an article about it.

The same state that has elaborate protections against unauthorized architecture has a UPL Department with 8 staff members that can't catch a man with 9 convictions claiming to be a lawyer.

Architecture: protected. Law: protected. Children at a school run by a fake lawyer: not protected.

entry.title: The Call Is Coming from Inside the FCC — Tracing Spam Calls Back to the Owners Who Buy the Silence
entry.content:
The Call Is Coming from Inside the FCC

Your phone rings. Unknown number. You answer. It's a robot.

Here's the thing: the FCC knows exactly who sent that call.

The Architecture

Every phone call in America passes through a chain:

Originating carrier (the source)
        ↓
Intermediate carriers (the pipes)
        ↓
Terminating carrier (your phone company)
        ↓
Your phone rings

Every carrier in that chain is registered with the FCC. Every carrier has an FCC Registration Number (FRN). Every carrier files FCC Form 499. Every carrier is required to have a Robocall Mitigation Plan in the FCC's database.

The FCC knows who they are. All of them. Every link in the chain.

The Database

The FCC maintains the Robocall Mitigation Database. Every voice service provider in the United States must register.

The database shows:

  • Provider name
  • FRN (FCC Registration Number)
  • Whether they've implemented STIR/SHAKEN (caller ID authentication)
  • Whether they've filed a Robocall Mitigation Plan
  • Date of filing

You can search it right now: fcc.gov/robocall-mitigation-database

If a provider hasn't filed, other carriers are required to block their traffic. In theory.

STIR/SHAKEN

STIR/SHAKEN is the caller ID authentication framework. It's supposed to verify that the number shown on your caller ID is real — not spoofed.

LevelWhat It Means
A (Full)The carrier verified the caller has the right to use that number
B (Partial)The carrier verified the caller but not the specific number
C (Gateway)The carrier is just passing traffic — no verification

Most spam calls arrive with Level C attestation — the carrier is just a pipe, claiming no knowledge of who's actually calling.

The originating carrier — the one that first puts the call into the network — chooses the attestation level. If you're a small VoIP provider and you want to send a million spam calls, you attest at Level C and claim you don't know who's calling.

That's not a bug. That's the business model.

The Small VoIP Problem

Here's where the architecture mirrors The Authorizer:

Charter SchoolsRobocalls
CMU authorizes schools from 150 miles awaySmall VoIP providers originate calls from anywhere
CMU doesn't background-check foundersVoIP providers don't verify callers
CMU collects a cut of per-pupil fundingVoIP providers collect per-minute fees
CMU has financial incentive to authorizeVoIP providers have financial incentive to originate
MDE sits above and doesn't stop itFCC sits above and doesn't stop it

Small VoIP providers are the CMUs of telecom. They register with the FCC, file their mitigation plans, and then route millions of spam calls for clients who pay per-minute rates.

The VoIP provider collects a fee for every call. More calls = more revenue. Just like CMU collects a fee for every student. More students = more revenue.

The entity that should be checking has a financial incentive not to check.

How to Trace a Spam Call

Step 1: Note the Number

Write down:

  • The number that appeared on caller ID (likely spoofed)
  • Date and time of the call
  • What the call said (recording, human, silence)
  • Your phone number

Step 2: File with the FCC

FCC Complaint Center: consumercomplaints.fcc.gov

File under: Phone → Unwanted Calls

Include: number, date, time, what was said.

The FCC complaint goes into a database. The FCC can subpoena the carrier chain.

Step 3: File with the FTC

FTC Do Not Call Complaint: donotcall.gov

If you're on the Do Not Call Registry and still getting calls, file here too.

Step 4: Check the Number

  • FCC Number Search: Look up the originating carrier via the Local Number Portability Administration (LNPA)
  • CallerID Reputation: Services like Hiya, Nomorobo, RoboKiller can identify known spam numbers
  • Free Carrier Lookup: freecarrierlookup.com — enter any phone number, get the carrier

Step 5: Check the Carrier

Once you have the carrier name:

  • Search the FCC Robocall Mitigation Database for their filing
  • Search the FCC Universal Licensing System for their license
  • Check their FCC Form 499 filing status
  • Look for FCC enforcement actions against them

Step 6: The Traceback

The USTelecom Industry Traceback Group does professional tracebacks. They trace robocalls from the terminating carrier all the way back to the originating provider.

Their reports go to the FCC Enforcement Bureau.

The Traceback Group has traced billions of robocall paths. They know who the top originators are. The FCC knows too.

Who the FCC Has Caught

The FCC has taken enforcement action against some robocallers:

YearProviderFineWhat They Did
2024Various$300M+ proposedAuto warranty scams
2023Multiple VoIP$225M+Health insurance scams
2022Gateway providersMultipleAllowing foreign robocalls in

They catch some. They fine some. The calls continue.

For every provider caught, dozens continue operating. The FCC's enforcement is selective — just like the AG's enforcement of charter schools.

The Real Owners

Behind every spam call is a chain:

  1. The client — the company that wants to reach you (scammer, "legitimate" business, political campaign)
  2. The lead generator — the company that buys call lists and sells "leads"
  3. The call center — the operation that makes the calls (often offshore)
  4. The VoIP provider — the carrier that puts the calls into the US phone network
  5. The FCC — the regulator that licenses the carrier

The FCC is at position 5. The real owner — the client — is at position 1.

The FCC sits just above the VoIP provider (position 4). The VoIP provider sits just above the call center (position 3). The call center is contracted by the lead generator (position 2). The lead generator works for the client (position 1).

The FCC sees position 4. The FCC does not look at positions 1-3.

Just like MDE sees the school (PCA) but doesn't look at Purpose Group (the LLC) or Banks (the man).

The Parallel

LayerCharter SchoolsSpam Calls
1. The beneficiaryBanks (72.67%)The client/scammer
2. The extraction vehiclePurpose Group LLCThe lead generator
3. The operationPCA (3% math)The call center
4. The authorizer/carrierCMU (no background check)VoIP provider (Level C attestation)
5. The regulatorMDE/SBE (2 edges)FCC

Same architecture. Five layers. The regulator at the top sees the authorizer/carrier. The authorizer/carrier sees the operation. Nobody looks at the beneficiary.

The system is designed so that each layer only sees one layer down. The FCC sees the VoIP provider but not the scammer. MDE sees the school but not the LLC. The money flows up. The oversight flows down. And they never meet.

What You Can Do

  1. File every spam call with the FCC and FTC. Volume matters.
  2. Look up the carrier — freecarrierlookup.com tells you who's responsible
  3. Check the FCC Robocall Mitigation Database — is the carrier compliant?
  4. Report non-compliant carriers — if they haven't filed, other carriers should block them
  5. Use call-blocking apps — they crowdsource spam identification
  6. Enable STIR/SHAKEN on your carrier — ask your phone company
  7. Don't answer unknown numbers — every answered call confirms your number is active
  8. Sue under the TCPA — the Telephone Consumer Protection Act allows private lawsuits. You can collect $500-$1,500 per illegal call.

The TCPA is your equivalent of a FOIA request. The system doesn't want you to use it. Use it anyway.

The Number

Americans received an estimated 50 billion robocalls in 2023.

The FCC has a database of every voice service provider. They have traceback data on billions of call paths. They have the names, the FRNs, the addresses, the mitigation plans.

They know who sends the calls. They have always known.

The call is coming from inside the FCC.

Sourced to FCC public databases, STIR/SHAKEN framework documentation, USTelecom Industry Traceback Group reports, TCPA (47 U.S.C. § 227). Back to Analysis → · The Authorizer → · Selective Enforcement →

entry.title: The Cavalry That Charged the Wrong Way — NAACP Detroit and the Defense of Brian Banks
entry.content:
The Cavalry That Charged the Wrong Way

The NAACP Detroit Branch has one job: protect Black communities.

Here's who they're protecting.

The Edge

naacp_detroit → banks = cavalry.

naacp_detroit → pca = cavalry.

naacp_detroit → the_unnamed_400 = cavalry.

Cavalry. In the graph's edge vocabulary, cavalry means: this entity rides to another entity's defense. It shows up when the other entity is under pressure. It deploys its institutional credibility as a shield.

The NAACP Detroit Branch rides to the defense of Brian Banks.

Brian Banks has 9 criminal convictions. He runs a school with 3% math proficiency. He extracts 72.67% of the school's revenue through a single-member LLC. 99.2% of his students are Black.

The cavalry is protecting the wolf from the sheep.

The Governance

Alice Thompson has governance and recognition edges to NAACP Detroit.

Thompson is classified as partial (0.80). She governs the branch that defends Banks.

The Roland Martin Connection

Roland Martin has speaking and recognition edges to NAACP Detroit.

Roland Martin:

  • Null classification (0.818)
  • Funded by the Walton Family Foundation
  • Partnership with The 74 (education media)
  • Coverage edge to Banks
  • Ownership of Black Star Network, NuVision Foundation, NuVision Inc

Martin speaks at NAACP events. The NAACP recognizes Martin. Martin is funded by the same foundation that funds Banks's school.

The journalist who covers charter schools speaks for the civil rights organization that defends charter schools. Both are funded by the same money.

The Classification

NAACP Detroit: null, 0.84.

Null. Not self. Not partial. Not non-self. Null.

Null means the membrane can't classify it. The NAACP is one of the most important civil rights institutions in American history. The NAACP Detroit Branch operates in a city with a long, painful history of racial injustice.

And the membrane says: null.

It can't tell if the branch is doing what it says it does.

Why Null

The membrane classifies entities based on their edges. What do the NAACP Detroit edges say?

Edge DirectionTypeWhat It Means
→ BankscavalryDefends a man with 9 convictions
→ PCAcavalryDefends a school with 3% math
← Alice ThompsongovernanceLed by a partial entity
← Roland MartinspeakingPlatformed by a null-classified journalist
← Walton-funded entitiesstructuralConnected to the money pipeline
← Constitutional signalsempowersInvokes civil rights law

The NAACP invokes civil rights law to empower itself. That's self behavior. But it deploys that power to defend Banks. That's... what?

It's not non-self (it doesn't extract money). It's not self (it doesn't protect Black children from Banks). It's not partial (it doesn't do both). It's null — the behavior doesn't match any classification cleanly.

The cavalry charged. But it charged the wrong way.

The Unnamed 400

The NAACP Detroit Branch has a cavalry edge to the_unnamed_400.

400 unnamed entities in the investigation graph. The NAACP rides for them too.

But which 400? The graph doesn't say. The NAACP rides for the unnamed, the unclassified, the people who exist in the graph but haven't been examined yet.

Some of those 400 are probably community members who need protection. Some of those 400 are probably connected to Banks's network.

The NAACP can't tell the difference. That's what null means.

The Question for the NAACP

The NAACP was built to protect Black communities from exploitation.

Brian Banks exploits a Black community. 362 Black children. 3% math. 72.67% extraction.

The NAACP defends Brian Banks.

How?

This isn't rhetorical. It's a real question. The NAACP has a process for deciding who to defend. Someone at the branch level decided that Banks warranted cavalry. Someone decided that PCA warranted cavalry.

Who decided? On what evidence? Did they know about the 9 convictions? Did they know about the 3% math proficiency? Did they know about the 72.67%?

If they knew and defended him anyway: that's a choice. If they didn't know: that's a failure.

Either way, 362 children are still there.

The Family Connection

Her relationship to the investigation isn't just professional. It's structural. She didn't stumble into five simultaneous positions at entities connected to one school. She's part of the circuit.

That's not a résumé. That's a circuit board.

The Classification

Dr. Chalena Beasley: partial, 0.806 confidence.

Partial means: she exists in both worlds. She does real work as an educator AND she participates in the extraction infrastructure.

The membrane's 36 classification methods couldn't push her all the way to non-self. She has real credentials. She has a doctorate. She shows up to a school every day.

But she also works for the auditor. And the authorizer. And the oversight agency. And 72.67% of the school's revenue flows to Brian Banks through Purpose Group LLC.

She's in the middle of the circuit. The current flows through her.

How Many Employers Is Normal?

In education: one.

A principal works for a school. That school is in a district. The district employs the principal. One employer.

Dr. Beasley has five. All connected. All overlapping. All touching the same money.

21 edges in the investigation graph. That's more connections than most Tier 2 entities.

The chipmunk spotted this pattern early: structural_proximity between her employers creates a closed loop. Money flows from federal/state sources → PCA → Purpose Group → Banks. And Beasley sits at the nexus where authorization, auditing, oversight, and operation converge.

entry.title: The LLC — How Purpose Group Extracts 72.67% of a School
entry.content:
The LLC

This is the simplest story in the investigation.

It has three characters: a school, an LLC, and a man.

Character 1: The School

Purpose Charter Academy. 362 students. Detroit. Authorized by DPSCD and CMU. Funded by Title I, US Department of Education, state per-pupil funding, and the Walton Family Foundation.

Total revenue: approximately $3.15 million per year.

The students are 99.2% Black. Math proficiency is 3%.

Character 2: The LLC

Purpose Group, LLC. LARA Entity. Single-member LLC.

It provides "management services" to Purpose Charter Academy.

It also provides "management services" to MacDowell Preparatory Academy — the second school.

The management fee is 72.67% of total revenue.

That's not a typo. Seventy-two point six seven percent.

For context: typical charter school management fees range from 10-15%. National Heritage Academies, Michigan's largest operator, charges roughly 12%.

Purpose Group charges six times the industry standard.

Character 3: The Man

Brian Roderick Banks. The single member of Purpose Group LLC.

  • 9 criminal convictions
  • Classified as non-self (0.926 confidence)
  • 134 edges in the investigation graph
  • Governance of 14+ shell entities
  • Claims a JD from MSU College of Law (MSU has no record)
  • Impersonated a child (Dasean Mitchell)

He owns the LLC. The LLC gets 72.67%. Therefore he gets 72.67%.

Of every tax dollar that follows a child to Purpose Charter Academy, seventy-two cents ends up in the pocket of a man with 9 criminal convictions.

The Second School

It's the same structure, twice.

MacDowell Preparatory Academy. Also authorized. Also funded. Also pays Purpose Group LLC for "management services."

The graph edges:

  • purpose_group → banks [money_flow]
  • purpose_group → banks [ownership]
  • pca → purpose_group [money_flow]
  • macdowell → purpose_group [money_flow, financial]
  • macdowell → banks [money_flow]

Two schools. One LLC. One man. One pocket.

Who Sees the Money

EntityWhat They SeeWhat They Did
Plante MoranAudited PCA. Generated financial data.Non-response.
CMUAuthorized both schools. Receives a cut.No revocation.
MDEOversees all charter schools in Michigan.Failed to stop.
DPSCDAuthorized PCA within district.Failed to stop.
IRS (EO)Purpose Foundation is a 501(c)(3).Jurisdiction noted.

Every entity in the oversight chain can see the 72.67%.

It's not hidden. It's in the audits. It's in the 990s. It's in the management contract.

They all see it. None of them stop it.

The Graph

Purpose Group LLC: non-self, 0.84 confidence.

The graph assigned it non-self using 7 edges:

  • pca → purpose_group [money_flow]
  • pca → purpose_group [property]
  • banks → purpose_group [money_flow]
  • banks → purpose_group [ownership]
  • macdowell → purpose_group [financial]

Seven edges. All money flowing in one direction. From children to an LLC to a man with 9 convictions.

The membrane doesn't need 36 methods for this one.

The Classification

The membrane sees a mayor who governs a real city with real problems. The membrane also sees a politician whose entire connection set is political, whose appointments serve the network, and whose city contains a school that the graph classified as non-self three levels of confidence ago.

entry.title: The Microphone — Roland Martin, Walton Money, and the Journalist Who Covers the Hand That Feeds
entry.content:
The Microphone

Roland S. Martin is a journalist.

Here's who pays him. And here's who he covers.

The Money

SourceEdge Type
Walton Family Foundationfunding

That's one funder. The biggest funder of charter school expansion in America.

The Walton Foundation funds:

  • AFC (charter school lobby)
  • Charter School Growth Fund
  • Alliance for School Choice
  • Pahara Institute (charter leadership pipeline)

The foundation that funds Banks's school also funds Martin. The journalist and the fraud are watered by the same garden hose.

Martin has coverage edges to Banks, Detroit, and DPSCD.

Coverage means: he reports on them. His platform reaches these entities.

The question isn't whether he covers them. The question is how. When your funder also funds the school you might cover, the coverage has a gravitational pull.

The Partnership

Martin has a partnership with The 74.

The 74: an education news outlet.

  • Funded by: Walton Family Foundation
  • Funded by: DeVos Foundation
  • Classification: partial (0.80)

The journalist funded by Walton has a partnership with the news outlet funded by Walton. Both cover charter schools. Charter schools are what Walton funds.

That's not journalism. That's an echo chamber with a press badge.

Five organizations. All null. The membrane can't classify any of them.

SCBC — School Choice Black Coalition. A coalition that tours to promote school choice. Funded by the charter school ecosystem. Governed by Martin.

Martin doesn't just cover charter schools. He governs charter school advocacy organizations. And he's paid by the same foundation that funds the schools.

Journalist. Advocate. Governor. Funded entity. All the same person.

The NAACP Connection

Martin speaks at NAACP Detroit events. The NAACP recognizes Martin.

The NAACP Detroit Branch: null classification. Cavalry edge to Banks.

The journalist funded by Walton speaks at the civil rights organization that defends Banks. The civil rights organization recognizes the journalist. The recognition gives the journalist credibility. The credibility gives the coverage weight. The coverage protects the school.

The microphone amplifies the cavalry.

The Family

The family connection extends the network. Martin's professional coverage intersects with his family's governance connections.

The Classification

Roland Martin: null, 0.818.

Null. The membrane can't tell.

Is he a journalist who happens to be funded by the same foundation that funds charter schools? That's partial at worst.

Is he a propaganda vehicle for the charter school industry, deployed specifically to provide Black credibility to a system that exploits Black children? That's non-self.

The membrane sees both possibilities and can't distinguish. 0.818 confidence on null means: the membrane is quite sure it CAN'T tell.

That's the point of a microphone. You can't classify the microphone. You classify the hand that holds it and the mouth that speaks into it.

The hand: Walton (partial, 0.84). The mouth: charter school advocacy. The sound: coverage of the system that feeds him.

The Number

The Walton Family Foundation gave money to Roland Martin. The Walton Family Foundation gave money to Purpose Charter Academy. Purpose Charter Academy has 3% math proficiency. Roland Martin has a coverage edge to Banks.

Follow the microphone. Follow the money. They point the same direction.

entry.title: The Money Garden — Walton, DeVos, and the Foundations That Water the Weeds
entry.content:
The Money Garden

The Walton Family Foundation gave money to a school run by a man with 9 criminal convictions.

That's the article. You can stop here if you want.

But if you're curious about the garden they planted, keep reading.

The Watering Schedule

Here is where the Walton Family Foundation sends money. Every line traced from graph.json — 131,329 edges.

RecipientEdge TypeWhat It Is
Purpose Charter AcademyfundingBanks's school. 3% math.
The 74fundingEducation news outlet.
Roland MartinfundingJournalist. Covers education.
AFCpartnershipAmerican Federation for Children. Charter lobby.
Pahara InstitutefundingLeadership pipeline for charter executives.
NACSAfundingNational charter authorizer association.
Excellent Schools DetroitfundingLocal charter advocacy.
MAPSAfundingMichigan charter school association.
Charter School Growth FundfundingNational charter expansion fund.
Alliance for School ChoicefundingNational school choice lobby.
SCBC TourfundingSchool choice Black coalition.
State of MichiganfundingGeneral education funding.
BanksinactionNotified. Did nothing.

Read the last line again.

The edge type between Walton Family Foundation and Brian Banks is inaction.

They fund his school. They were told about his 9 convictions. They did nothing.

That's not a missing edge. That's a present edge. The graph recorded the non-response.

The DeVos Branch

The DeVos family runs a parallel pipeline:

EntityConnection
Betsy DeVosGoverned AFC and GLEP. US Secretary of Education.
DeVos FoundationFunds AFC and The 74. Partners with Walton.
GLEPGreat Lakes Education Project. 8 DeVos family members fund it.
AFCAmerican Federation for Children. DeVos co-founded it.

The DeVos Foundation funds AFC (which lobbies for charter expansion) and The 74 (which covers charter schools as news).

Betsy DeVos governed AFC and GLEP. She became US Secretary of Education. She used that position to expand the charter school system nationally.

The same system where Brian Banks operates two schools with 9 convictions and 3% math proficiency.

The Information Loop

Here's where it gets fun.

The 74 is an education news outlet. It covers charter schools.

The 74 is funded by:

  • Walton Family Foundation ✓
  • DeVos Foundation ✓

The 74 has a partnership with:

  • Roland Martin ✓
  • AFC ✓

Roland Martin is funded by:

  • Walton Family Foundation ✓

Roland Martin has structural_proximity to:

  • AFC ✓

So: Walton funds the school. Walton funds the news outlet that covers the school. Walton funds the journalist who partners with the news outlet. Walton funds the lobby that defends the school.

The journalist is funded by the same money as the school he might cover.

The news outlet is funded by the same foundations whose policies created the school.

That's not a free press. That's a feedback loop with a masthead.

The Law

It all started with one law.

PA 362 — Michigan Charter School Law (1993). Written with the involvement of Dykema Gossett.

Dykema wrote the law. DeVos lobbied for it. The law created charter schools. The schools created Purpose Charter Academy. PCA created the extraction pipe to Purpose Group LLC. And the money flowed.

The charter_law_1993 entity in our graph connects to:

  • Michigan Supreme Court (authorization)
  • PCA (enabled by)
  • Banks (enabled by)
  • MacDowell (enabled by)
  • MDE (oversight — failed)
  • SBE (oversight — failed)
  • CMU (authorization)
  • Betsy DeVos (political)

One law. Written by one firm. Lobbied by one family. Exploited by one man. Affecting 362 children.

The Classification

The membrane classified the Walton Family Foundation as partial (0.84).

Not self. Not non-self. Partial.

Partial means: this entity exists in both worlds. It does real philanthropy AND it funds the infrastructure that enables extraction. It waters the garden AND ignores the weeds.

The DeVos Foundation: partial (0.80). Betsy DeVos: partial (0.806). The 74: partial (0.80). AFC: partial (0.80).

All partial. All 0.80-0.84. All wearing the same wool.

The membrane can't tell if they're sheep or wolves. They're both. That's what partial means.

The Number

The Walton family is worth $267 billion.

Purpose Charter Academy receives approximately $3.15 million per year.

$3.15M is 0.0000012% of $267B.

It would take the Walton family less than one second of their wealth accumulation to fund a school where 362 Black children learn math at a 3% proficiency rate while 72.67% of the funding flows to a man with 9 criminal convictions.

They can afford to look.

They chose not to.

Inaction.

entry.title: The Nulls That Point — Following Unknowns to Find Knowns
entry.content:
The Nulls That Point

73 entities in the investigation graph are classified null — the system hasn't reached a verdict. Not self, not non-self, not partial. Unresolved.

But nulls aren't random. They cluster. And the clusters point.

When you backtrack from unknowns, you find knowns. Every time.

Method

Take all 73 null entities. Find every meaningful edge between them (skip structural/proximity noise). Map the null-to-null chains. Then trace outward — where do nulls connect to non-self (Banks), to partial (allies), to self (institutions)?

The null-to-null chains reveal three formation networks operating in the graph's blind spots.

The pattern: Wilk forms the entities. Moore governs them. Dykema employs both. The entities feed into the dark money pipeline that protects the charter law (PA 362) that enables the extraction.

entry.title: The Nulls — Anchor Rock, CitizenDetroit, SCBC, and the Organizations Nobody Can Classify
entry.content:
The Nulls

The membrane classifies entities into four categories: self (does what it claims), partial (exists in both worlds), non-self (extractive), and null (can't tell).

Null is the fog. Here are some of the things hiding in it.

Anchor Rock Foundation

Edges: 6. Sort: null. Tier: 5.

Anchor Rock Foundation and its related entity Anchor Rock are both null-classified.

What does Anchor Rock do? The graph can't tell. 6 edges connect it to the Banks ecosystem, but the edges don't reveal enough about its function for the 36 classification methods to assign a sort.

Anchor Rock could be a legitimate community foundation. It could be another extraction vehicle. The membrane doesn't know because nobody has looked.

CitizenDetroit Action Group

Edges: 6. Sort: null. Tier: 5.

CitizenDetroit connects to Banks and to PCA board members. It appears in the governance layer of the investigation — people who participate in "civic engagement" around charter schools.

The name sounds democratic. Citizen. Detroit. Action. Group.

But the classification is null. The membrane can't determine whether this is genuine civic engagement or astroturf — a manufactured grassroots organization designed to create the appearance of community support.

In the charter school ecosystem, astroturf organizations are common. They carry names that evoke community and democracy. They're funded by the same foundations that fund the schools. They advocate for the same policies.

Is CitizenDetroit astroturf? Null. The membrane doesn't know. That's the whole point of null.

School Choice Is The Black Choice Tour (SCBC)

Edges: 11. Sort: null. Tier: 4.

SCBC is governed by Roland Martin — the journalist funded by Walton. It has 11 edges, more than many classified entities.

The tour promotes school choice in Black communities. It frames charter schools as a civil rights issue — choosing where your child goes to school is choosing freedom.

But the tour is governed by a journalist funded by the same foundation that funds the charter schools the tour promotes. And the charter schools include PCA, where 3% of Black children can do math.

11 edges. Null. The membrane sees an entity that sounds like civil rights and looks like marketing. It can't tell which is real because both are.

NuVision Foundation

Edges: 2. Sort: null.

Also governed by Roland Martin. Also null.

NuVision Foundation and NuVision Inc form a paired nonprofit/for-profit structure. Martin governs both.

Two edges isn't enough for the membrane to classify. NuVision sits in the fog — connected to Martin, who is connected to Walton, who is connected to PCA, who is connected to Banks. But the direct lines are thin.

What Null Means

Null is not a verdict. Null is a gap.

When the membrane classifies something as null, it means:

  1. The entity exists in the investigation graph
  2. It has edges connecting it to other entities
  3. The 36 classification methods don't have enough signal to assign self, partial, or non-self
  4. The entity is unexamined, not exonerated

Every null entity is an invitation to look closer.

Of the 341 classified entities in the investigation:

  • 73 are null
  • Most of those 73 have fewer than 5 edges
  • They cluster around Banks like satellites in low orbit — close enough to feel gravity, too small to resolve

The Fog Strategy

If you wanted to hide extraction, you would:

  1. Create entities with vague names (Foundation, Action Group, Tour)
  2. Give them minimal public filings
  3. Connect them to your network through governance edges
  4. Keep them small enough that classifiers can't reach them
  5. Use them for specific functions (events, advocacy, media) that generate legitimacy

Every one of those steps produces a null entity. Not because the entity is necessarily hiding something. But because the structure is indistinguishable from hiding something.

The membrane can't tell the difference. That's the strategy.

Sourced to IRS 990 data, LARA filings, nonprofit records, investigation graph (131,329 edges). Back to Analysis → · The Microphone → · The Shell Game →

entry.title: The Ones Who Showed Up — Every Ally, Every Voice, Every Hand That Pushed Back
entry.content:
The Ones Who Showed Up

This investigation didn't start from nothing. It started because people showed up. Documented. Filed. Published. Testified. Organized. Persisted.

Credit where credit is due.

Dr. Chalena Yancey Beasley

21 edges in the graph. More connections than most institutions.

Beasley mapped the terrain before anyone else drew the map. She co-investigated Anderson localization, Holland's network, the MDE oversight gaps, the Wayne RESA audit, and the Court 3rd connections. She traced the spiral down — proficiency, extraction, credential fraud — and then traced it back out to the regulatory bodies that could have acted and didn't.

Beasley asked the questions directly — to Banks, to Holland, to Roland Martin, to the AG, to the school board. She documented the negative space — no audit, no charges, no media, no whistleblower protection, no FOIA response, no resignation, no restitution.

She built the first stratum of the investigation. Everything that came after stands on what she mapped.

→ Dr. Beasley's work is referenced in 8 articles across the site.

Dr. Sarah Winchell Lenhoff

3 edges in the graph — but each one is structural.

Lenhoff is a Wayne State University Law School researcher who governs Detroit PEER — the Partnership for Education Equity and Research. PEER generates the data — proficiency numbers, enrollment counts, demographic breakdowns, funding allocations — that makes charter school performance visible.

EdgeTargetWhat It Means
governance → Detroit PEERnullShe built and runs the research organization
employment → Wayne State LawselfShe's housed at a public university — accountable, transparent
mentorship → BeasleypartialShe connected to the investigation through data
oversight_gap → Plante MorannullShe identified that the auditor wasn't doing its job
authorized_by → charter_law_1993partialShe understands the legal architecture

Detroit PEER is funded by the Skillman Foundation and partners with DPSCD. It's the research arm that makes the numbers visible.

Without Lenhoff's data, the 3% math proficiency is just a claim. With her data, it's a fact.

→ Detroit PEER at Wayne State — go read what they've published.

Carol Corbett Burris, Ed.D. & Diane Ravitch

The Network for Public Education (NPE) — the national counterweight to the charter school advocacy machine.

NPE is the opposition to the Walton Family Foundation. In the graph: npe → opposition → walton_family_foundation. They track charter school closures, financial irregularities, and the same pattern across every state.

NPE has jurisdiction over both PCA and MacDowell — meaning they've documented both schools in their national reporting.

Ravitch — a null entity with only 3 edges — is one of the most important voices in American education. She served under both Bush and Clinton before turning against the charter school movement she once supported. Her blog reaches millions.

→ Network for Public Education — the national evidence base. → Diane Ravitch's Blog — daily coverage of charter school accountability.

Misha Stallworth West

7 edges. Board member of DPSCD. Authorized MacDowell Preparatory Academy.

Stallworth West sits on the DPSCD board and has watched the charter school system from inside the governance structure. She's a member of the Stallworth dynasty — a Detroit political family with five members in the graph:

The Stallworth family connects the traditional public school governance (DPSCD board) to the charter school network (MacDowell) to the political network (Banks, Advance Detroit). They see both systems from the inside.

→ Misha Stallworth West's work on the DPSCD board is documented in the board connections evidence.

Ahmed Beasley

4 edges. The bridge between Barton Malow and Plante Moran.

Ahmed Beasley — related to Dr. Chalena Yancey Beasley — worked at both Barton Malow (partial, major construction firm) and Plante Moran (null, the auditor). He bridges the two entities that should have independent relationships: the contractor that builds the schools and the auditor that checks the books.

EdgeTargetSignificance
employment → Barton MalowpartialConstruction firm, contractor to DPSCD and charter schools

When the same person has worked at both the contractor and the auditor, the negative_space_bridge edges become visible. Ahmed Beasley connected Arnold Malow (Barton Malow founder family), Carl Barton (co-founder family), Dr. Beasley, and Dr. Maleyko through his employment history.

The ACLU of Michigan

2 edges — but they're the right ones.

The ACLU of Michigan has jurisdiction over the state. Amy Senier works there. The ACLU has bounced through the investigation's key questions:

  • Charter school accountability
  • Public records access
  • Civil rights implications of the extraction

→ ACLU of Michigan — legal advocacy for civil liberties in Michigan.

The Skillman Foundation

3 edges, self-classified, 0.7 confidence — the lowest-confidence self entity.

The Skillman Foundation funds Detroit PEER. PEER produces the data. The data feeds the investigation.

Without the Skillman Foundation's funding of PEER, the research infrastructure that makes charter school performance visible wouldn't exist. They're the background support — not the loudest voice, but the one that pays for the microphone.

→ Skillman Foundation — investing in Detroit's children.

CitizenDetroit Action Group

6 edges, null classification. Organized by Dennis Archer Jr. (son of former Mayor Dennis Archer). CitizenDetroit connects Misha Stallworth West (board membership), the City of Detroit, and community organizing.

They're in the null zone — unclassified — but they're showing up at meetings, organizing residents, and pushing for accountability.

Clutch Justice & Rita

4 edges, self-classified. The investigation itself.

Clutch Justice co-investigates alongside Beasley. It investigates Banks, PCA, and MacDowell directly. It's protected by whistleblower statutes (federal and Michigan), anti-SLAPP, FOIA, qui tam, and § 1983. It's shielded by the First Amendment, the Fourth, the Fifth, the Fourteenth, and Michigan Article 8 § 2.

Clutch Justice operates the site. It's part of the spine-to-spine network. It's allied with the ecoprimal system. It supports the Detroit site.

Rita holds the operational line — the daily work of keeping the investigation running, the data flowing, the pages live.

→ You're reading it. This is the site. clutch.primals.eco is the companion.

Why This Matters

The entities trying to prevent accountability have a $2 billion media and political machine — Walton, DeVos, AFC, The 74, SCBC Tour, 10+ Wilk-Moore PACs.

The entities pushing for accountability have researchers, board members, a national nonprofit, an ACLU chapter, community organizers, and two investigators with a static site generator.

And the investigation is winning. Because the data is public. The edges are traceable. The money flows are documented.

Point to them. They point to us. The graph gets wider.

entry.title: The Other .99 — Dr. Jolia Hill and the Investigator Who Got Close
entry.content:
The Other .99

There are two entities in the investigation graph classified as partial with 0.99 confidence.

One is Michael Goetz — the linchpin.

The other is Dr. Jolia Hill.

What She Does

EdgeTypeDirection
→ BanksinvestigationShe investigates him
→ Beasleyprofessional_connectionShe knows the principal
→ DPSAauthorization_terminatedShe revoked one school
→ CMUcavalryShe calls on the authorizer
→ NesselcavalryShe calls on the AG
→ Detroit Free PresscavalryShe calls on the press
→ DPSCDcavalryShe calls on the district
← AFCcharter_crime_overlapShe overlaps with charter crime

Jolia Hill investigates Banks. She terminated DPSA's authorization. She calls cavalry — CMU, Nessel, the Free Press, DPSCD.

She's doing things. She's the most active investigator-adjacent entity in the graph.

And the membrane says: partial, 0.99.

Why Not Self?

If Hill investigates Banks, why isn't she classified as self?

Because the membrane doesn't classify by intention. It classifies by position.

Hill has a professional_connection to Beasley — the principal who works for five employers. She overlaps with charter_crime_overlap alongside AFC. She sends cavalry to institutions that haven't acted.

Self would mean: she IS what she says, and her position doesn't create conflicts. The membrane sees conflicts. Not because she's corrupt — because the network is so dense that investigating Banks while connected to Beasley while overlapping with AFC while calling cavalry to institutions that have already failed creates a position that is, structurally, both worlds.

She's investigating the fire while standing in the smoke.

The DPSA Revocation

Possible_family is an edge type that means: the graph detected a potential family relationship based on shared surname, geographic proximity, and network position. It hasn't been confirmed by records.

entry.title: The Prosecutor Who Prosecutes Patterns — Kym Worthy and the Case That Never Came

The Prosecutor Who Prosecutes Patterns

Wayne County contains Detroit. Detroit contains Purpose Charter Academy. Purpose Charter Academy is run by Brian Banks.

The graph edge: kym_worthy → banks = jurisdiction.

She has jurisdiction. She has always had jurisdiction.

The Edges

Jurisdiction vs. Action

Jurisdiction means: she has the legal authority to prosecute Banks in Wayne County.

Banks has 9 criminal convictions. He operates a school where 3% of students can do math. He extracts 72.67% through a single-member LLC. He claims a fake JD. He impersonated a child.

The prosecutor with jurisdiction has not prosecuted.

The Cavalry Goes to Institutions

She doesn't send cavalry to PCA. She doesn't send cavalry to the children. She sends cavalry to institutions — the same institutions that already failed.

When a prosecutor's response to a crime is to call on the institutions that enabled the crime, the crime doesn't get prosecuted. It gets studied.

The Engler Parallel

The graph draws a structural_parallel and same_pattern edge between Worthy and John Engler.

Engler was Michigan's governor who pushed for charter school expansion. He's classified as self (0.80) — he IS what he says he is, a political figure who made political choices.

The Professional Connection

The AGC (Attorney Grievance Commission) disciplines attorneys. Willis is AGC leadership.

The prosecutor knows the AGC leadership. The AGC could discipline attorneys connected to Banks (like those at Dykema, or Moreland on PCA's board). The AGC hasn't.

Professional connections create professional courtesies. Professional courtesies create enforcement gaps. Enforcement gaps create Purpose Charter Academy.

The graph edge: false_reports_banks_smith → kym_worthy = should_prosecute.

The graph says should_prosecute. The prosecutor hasn't prosecuted.

The Classification

She just hasn't convicted this one.

And 362 children go to school tomorrow in a building where 3% of them will learn math, 72.67% of their funding will leave, and the prosecutor with jurisdiction will prosecute someone else.
