Source: ec2-98-91-77-46.compute-1.amazonaws.com
Target: detroit.primals.eco/analysis/dark-money-pipeline/
Response: HTTP 200

The signal crossed from tuebor to detroit. Someone — or something following links — navigated from the tuebor analysis to the full evidence library at detroit.primals.eco. The dark-money-pipeline page connects Banks to the broader financial network.

T+14:58 — 🔴 Lansing, Michigan (20:58:56 UTC)

AT&T residential connection in Lansing, Michigan:

Source: 162-226-225-148.lightspeed.lnngmi.sbcglobal.net
                                      ^^^^ ^^
                                      LNNG MI = LANSING, MICHIGAN
Network: AT&T / SBC Global (residential broadband)
Pages visited:
  barry.primals.eco/analysis/tommy-boy/     ← Barrett dark money analysis
  barry.primals.eco/desk/                   ← workbench interface
  tuebor.primals.eco/                       ← homepage

This is a human in Lansing, Michigan. Multiple pages, multiple sites, browsing behavior — not a bot. Lansing is the state capital. Home of:

  • The Attorney General's office
  • The Michigan Department of Education
  • LARA (Licensing and Regulatory Affairs)
  • The Governor's office
  • The State Legislature

An AT&T residential user in Lansing reading the tommy-boy analysis (Barrett's dark money connections) and browsing the desk workbench. The signal reached the state capital.

T+15:00 — Detroit Evidence Library Active (20:58:59–21:00 UTC)

Multiple IPs from around the world began accessing detroit.primals.eco evidence pages:

TimeIPNetworkPage
20:58:59117.132.188.205China Mobiledetroit.primals.eco/ (home)
20:59:16102.64.161.246GVA Togo/entities/original-eastside-slate/
20:59:2351.14.162.197BT (UK)/connections/credential-compliance/
20:59:29213.139.52.53JTG (Jordan)/entities/macdowell-preparatory-academy/
20:59:34189.4.79.52Virtua (Brazil)/connections/systemic-analysis/
20:59:41172.56.198.40T-Mobile USA/connections/credential-washing/
20:59:46178.34.136.31Rostelecom (Russia)/connections/weekly-meetings/

The T-Mobile USA hit is notable — a mobile phone in the United States reading about credential washing. T-Mobile IPs don't resolve to geography, but this is an American reading about how Banks obtained credentials despite 9 convictions.

T+16:30 — .env Scanner Detected (20:59:31 UTC)

Google Cloud IP (35.214.204.78) launched an automated .env file scanner against the infrastructure:

Source: 78.204.214.35.bc.googleusercontent.com (Google Cloud)
Attack: 206 requests probing for .env, .env.local, .env.production,
        .env.backup, .git/config, etc.
Verdict: All returned 404 or static HTML. No secrets exposed.

The immune membrane's static file serving means there is nothing to find. The scanner hit a wall of HTML.

Epitope tagged. This IP is now classified by the scatter/bloom immune system.

Permeability Map — What the Data Shows

                    SIGNAL SOURCE
                    eco.primal@pm.me
                         │
                    ProtonMail relay
                         │
              ┌──────────┼──────────┐
              ▼                     ▼
        ┌──────────┐         ┌──────────┐
        │ Barracuda│         │  Other   │
        │   ESS    │         │recipients│
        │ SCANNED ✓│         │ (silent) │
        └────┬─────┘         └──────────┘
             │
             │ T+36s: email delivered
             ▼
        ┌──────────┐
        │ Recipient│
        │  inbox   │
        └────┬─────┘
             │
     ┌───────┴───────┐
     ▼               ▼
  ┌──────┐     ┌──────────┐
  │Slack/│     │ Forward  │
  │Teams │     │ to group │
  │share │     │          │
  └──┬───┘     └────┬─────┘
     │              │
     ▼              ▼
  AWS Ohio     AWS Virginia
  preview      BOTH articles
  T+1:35       T+4:39
     │              │
     │              ▼
     │         Detroit crossover
     │         dark-money-pipeline
     │         T+11:52
     │
     └──► [WAITING: human browser clicks]
          [WAITING: .gov / .edu / MI IPs]
          [WAITING: enforcement action]

What Is Permeable

BoundaryStatusEvidence
ProtonMail → recipient email system✅ PermeableBarracuda scan at T+36s
Email → messaging platform✅ PermeableAWS preview bots at T+1:34
First share → second share✅ PermeableBoth articles shared at T+4:39
tuebor → detroit (cross-site)✅ PermeableDark money pipeline hit at T+11:52
Search engines✅ IndexingGoogle + Bing crawling enforcement article

What Is Not Yet Permeable

BoundaryStatusWhat Would Show Permeability
Email → human browser click✅ PermeableAT&T Lansing, MI — tommy-boy + desk
State capital → investigation⏳ WaitingReturn traffic from .gov/.state.mi.us IPs
Investigation → action⏳ WaitingContact from enforcement, subpoena, filing
DPSCD → authorization review⏳ WaitingBoard meeting agenda, public comment
AG → UPL investigation⏳ WaitingAGC/AG office traffic pattern

The Localization Question

In a functioning system, the evidence signal should propagate through each oversight boundary without attenuation:

  1. Evidence published → oversight bodies notified → investigation opened → action taken → children protected

In an Anderson-localized system, the signal attenuates at each boundary:

  1. Evidence published → oversight notified → complaint acknowledged → referred to another body → referred again → no action → signal dies

The Enforcement Ecosystem documents ten oversight bodies with jurisdiction over Brian Roderick Banks. As of October 7, 2026, the State Bar and AGC exchanged letters one day apart, each pointing at the other door. The signal bounced between two boundaries and stopped.

This page measures whether the new signal — with full documentation, cross-referenced evidence, and verification instructions — propagates through the system or localizes again.

Live Metrics

Updated as data arrives. This section will be revised with each new propagation event.

MetricValue
Signal emittedOct 9, 2026, 20:43 UTC
First boundary crossedT+36 seconds (Barracuda ESS)
Amplification events3 (messaging shares)
Cross-site propagation1 (tuebor → detroit evidence library)
Lansing, MI human visitT+14:58 — AT&T residential, state capital
Unique IPs (investigation sites)20+
Pages scannedBanks, Enforcement, Dark Money, Tommy Boy, Desk, MacDowell entity
Human browser clicks1 confirmed (Lansing, MI)
T-Mobile USA (mobile)1 (credential-washing page)
.gov / .edu IPs0 confirmed (cloud proxies possible)
.env attack detected206 probes from Google Cloud — blocked
Enforcement responseSee Oct 12 update below
Children still enrolled under BanksYes
Last updatedOct 12, 2026, 13:30 UTC

October 12, 2026 — Wave 1 Signal + Three Responses

T+3 days — Second Signal Emitted (Oct 12, 9:04 AM EDT / 13:04 UTC)

A second email was sent to 88 recipients — every oversight body, every press outlet, every institutional actor with jurisdiction. Subject: "I know all of you. Your names are on it. Can't wait to see you in court." All evidence links included. All 88 recipients visible to each other on the CC line.

T+3d 13min — 🟢 STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION: PERSONAL CELL (13:17 UTC)

Nikki Snyder (SBE member, R-Goodrich) responded in 13 minutes with her personal cell phone number.

From: SnyderN@michigan.gov
Response time: 13 minutes
Content: "Please feel free to call or text me. [personal cell]"

This is signal propagation. The evidence reached an elected state official with oversight authority over charter authorizers. She didn't acknowledge receipt. She didn't point to a procedure. She gave her personal number.

Snyder is an EMU graduate (the same university whose charter office just terminated DPSA — another Banks-network school). She's a nurse and disability advocate. Her kids are in public school. She has no financial or political connection to the Banks network.

Anderson localization test: PASSED at this boundary. The signal propagated through the SBE membrane into a named actor with constitutional authority.

T+3d ~15min — 🟡 WALTON FAMILY FOUNDATION: MEDIA DESK (13:19 UTC)

From: wffnews@wffmail.com
Response time: ~15 minutes
Content: Media desk auto-response

Walton ($5.7B grantmaking, MAPSA $4.3M+ to Michigan) routed to media desk. Corporate defense posture. The signal reached the membrane but reflected. Expected behavior for a Tier 5 (hostile/defensive) node.

T+3d 23min — 🟢 JUDICIAL TENURE COMMISSION: FORMAL ACKNOWLEDGMENT (13:27 UTC)

From: JudicialTenure@courts.mi.gov
Response time: 23 minutes
Content: "The staff of the Judicial Tenure Commission has received
your email message. As you were advised in an email response
sent to you on September 21 of this year, the Commission
cannot take any action in response to an email message."

Read that again. The JTC says it "cannot take any action in response to an email message."

But the JTC already acknowledged five formal Requests for Investigation on September 24, 2026. Those are pending. Staff were assigned. The complainant filed correctly.

The JTC response on October 12 treats the email as if it came from a stranger — "as you were advised on September 21" — when they have five open investigations from this complainant. They are not saying they won't investigate. They are saying they can't act on email. This is a procedure gate, not a refusal.

But compare the framing: Snyder gave her personal cell. The JTC gave a form letter. Same evidence. Same complainant. Same 88-person CC line. One institution absorbed the signal. The other reflected it with bureaucratic padding.

Anderson localization test at JTC boundary: INCONCLUSIVE. The formal RFIs are still open. The JTC acknowledged this complainant in September. The October response is pro forma. The question is whether the pending investigations produce action — not whether the email got a warm reply.

Summary: October 12 Permeability Update

BoundaryStatusResponse TimeSignal Type
SBE → Snyder✅ Propagated13 minPersonal cell number
Walton → Media desk🔴 Reflected~15 minAuto-response, corporate defense
JTC → Staff⚠️ Acknowledged23 minBoilerplate — but 5 RFIs already open
AGC⏳ Silent—No response yet
MDE⏳ Silent—No response yet
DPSCD OIG⏳ Silent—No response yet
AG Office⏳ Silent—No response yet
Press (all)⏳ Silent—No response yet

Key finding: The signal propagated fastest through the elected board (SBE) — not through the enforcement bodies (JTC, AGC, AG). This is consistent with the Institutional Immunity Pattern: the system processes complaints through bureaucratic channels that attenuate the signal. Elected officials who answer their own email don't have that filter.

Oct 12 delta: 3 responses in 23 minutes. +1 confirmed propagation (SBE). +1 reflected (Walton). +1 acknowledged with procedure gate (JTC).

Why This Matters

362 students attend MacDowell Preparatory Academy. More attend Purpose Charter Academy. 99.2% are Black. 92% are economically disadvantaged. Math proficiency is 3% .

The man running both schools has 9 criminal convictions. He falsely claims to be an attorney. He denied a parent with custody rights access to their child. He filed a PPO against the parent who complained. His board chair is a sitting judge in the court that processes the PPO.

Every fact is independently verifiable. The evidence library is 287+ pages. The criminal record is public. The board of directors is on the school's own website.

The question is not whether the evidence exists. The question is whether the system can absorb it.

If the signal propagates — if oversight bodies investigate, if enforcement acts, if the authorizer reviews — then the system works. Slowly, perhaps. But it works.

If the signal localizes — if it bounces between jurisdictions, if complaints are acknowledged and filed, if letters are exchanged between offices that point at each other — then the disorder is structural. The medium itself prevents propagation. And the children remain enrolled in a school run by a convicted felon who blocks parents at the door.

Anderson's insight: in a sufficiently disordered system, no wave propagates. The question for Michigan's oversight system is whether the disorder has crossed that threshold.

We are measuring.

Connected Analysis

  • They Banked on Banks — The full analysis of Brian Roderick Banks, the access denial, the PPO weapon, the board, the cycle
  • The Enforcement Ecosystem — Ten oversight bodies, the jurisdictional gaps, the State Bar / AGC referral loop
  • Anderson Localization — Hemlock — The same physics applied to a rural Michigan subgraph
  • Cross-Subgraph Patterns — How Detroit, Saginaw, Barry, Macomb, and Allegan connect through the same failing nodes

Evidence library: detroit.primals.eco — 287+ pages, every claim sourced to public records.

The signal was sent. The evidence is public. The verification takes minutes.

We are watching whether it propagates — or localizes.

This page is the measurement. It will be updated as data arrives.

entry.title: Sitting in a Tree — Mike and Tom and Dykema and Banks
entry.content:
Sitting in a Tree

You know the rhyme.

Mike and Tom, sitting in a tree K-I-S-S-I-N-G

But who's the tree?

The tree is Dykema Gossett PLLC — Michigan's largest law firm. $200–300 million in annual revenue. Offices in six states and Washington, D.C. It doesn't pick sides. It grows branches for whoever pays.

Mike Rogers sits on one branch. Tom Barrett sits on another. Brian Banks — 9 criminal convictions, superintendent of two charter schools, no bar admission for his claimed J.D. — sits on a third.

Same tree. Same roots. Same trunk. Same person watering all of it.

Every claim below is sourced to FEC filings, LARA entity records, IRS 990 data, TransparencyUSA, campaign finance records, or published reporting. No private information. No tracking. Verify everything at the bottom.

The Tree

Dykema Gossett operates two political action committees:

Federal PAC (FEC C00793976):

  • $4,000 → Tom Barrett for Congress

State PAC (TransparencyUSA): $725,000+ total expenditures

  • $62,000 → House Republican Campaign Committee
  • $58,750 → Senate Republican Campaign Committee
  • $45,000 → Michigan House Democratic Fund
  • $44,000 → Michigan Senate Democratic Fund
  • $13,500 → Mike Duggan Campaign
  • $15,500 → Aric Nesbitt (R)
  • $8,250 → Matt Hall (R)
  • $8,250 → Sam Singh (D)
  • $7,750 → Winnie Brinks (D)
  • $250 → Tenisha Yancey (D)

Yancey is the 36th District Court judge who chairs the board of Banks' MacDowell Preparatory Academy. Her campaign's sole expenditure was $383.82 to Banks Strategy & Consultants LLC.

The tree doesn't pick a side. The tree picks every side.

Branch 1: Mikey

Mike Rogers is running for U.S. Senate. He has accepted $88.8M in outside support — the largest outside spending operation in Michigan history.

Rogers' top donors and Dykema share infrastructure:

DonorGave to Rogers (via GLCF)Also Gave to BarrettAlso Connected to Dykema
Kenneth Griffin (Citadel)$2,500,000 $7,000 ✓ Cross-ticket bridge
Stephen Schwarzman (Blackstone)$4,500,000Maxed out✓ Cross-ticket bridge
Tim Dunn (CrownQuest)$10,000,000——

Griffin and Schwarzman fund BOTH the Senate candidate (Rogers) AND the House candidate (Barrett). The same wallets feed both branches of the same tree.

Rogers authored CISPA — the surveillance bill that would have exempted all privacy law. It was killed twice by the Senate he now wants to join. He was hired by AT&T after chairing the committee that investigated AT&T's competitor. He bought a $1.6 million house in Florida while running for Michigan.

He'll eat anything they feed him. Full record: Hey Mikey, He Likes It!

Branch 2: Tommy

Tom Barrett represents Michigan's 7th Congressional District. On August 13, 2026, he called his Democratic opponent — a tenant organizer with an expunged pipeline protest arrest — a "convicted felon."

Barrett received $4,000 from Dykema Gossett Federal PAC.

The same Dykema Gossett whose attorney incorporated a dark money entity whose president is Kenneth Daniels — convicted federal felon, structured $19,000 in cash for a $21 million drug ring (DEA, May 12, 2014).

Barrett's campaign also benefited from $6,300,000 in NRCC spending in MI-7, including a mailer calling his opponent a "socialist felon." His strategist Jason Roe received $782,000 from Barrett's PAC — more than the candidate paid for any other service.

He ran a wrong-date election ad in a newspaper serving Black voters. Michigan's Attorney General sent a cease-and-desist letter.

The word "felon" travels outward. Actual felons travel inward. Full record: Tommy Boy

Branch 3: The Dark Money

This is the branch that connects the candidates to the charter school.

Dykema attorney W. Alan Wilk — Team Leader, Political Compliance, Elections & Campaign Finance — incorporated at least three dark money vehicles:

Save Detroit Jobs → Impact Detroit → Detroit Leaders

FieldValue
LARA802002459
Incorporated byW. Alan Wilk (Dykema)
Phone on IRS filing517-374-9100 — this is Dykema's Lansing office number
Tax return preparerDykema Gossett PLLC (EIN 381446628)
Preparer employeeOlivia RC A Flower (Dykema, Ann Arbor)

If you call Save Detroit Jobs, you reach Dykema. If SDJ files its tax return, Dykema prepares it. If you look up SDJ's officers, three of five have direct Dykema employment:

OfficerSDJ RoleDykema Connection
Kenneth DanielsPresidentConvicted federal felon. Kwame Kilpatrick appointee.
Damian C. MitchellTreasurerPolice board candidate (disqualified).
Renae MooreAsst SecretaryDykema Senior Compliance Specialist (current employee)
Rebecca VykydalAsst TreasurerFormer Dykema Compliance Coordinator (2020–2022)
W. Alan WilkIncorporatorDykema Team Leader, Political Compliance

SDJ spent $84,000 in the 2021 Detroit City Council District 2 race — defeating M.L. Elrick (the Detroit Free Press journalist who investigated Banks' criminal record) and electing Latisha Johnson.

Latisha Johnson now serves as Board Secretary of Purpose Charter Academy — the charter school founded by Brian Banks.

The money moved: Dykema → SDJ → Johnson campaign → Johnson on Banks' school board.

Our Neighborhoods First

Same attorney (Wilk). Same compliance (Moore). Different beneficiary: Mike Duggan (mayor).

  • Ran attack ads against Duggan's opponent
  • Officers include Betty Brooks (ex-police commissioner, Duggan "dear friend of 30 years")
  • Lorna Thomas (Public Lighting Authority, Duggan appointee) chairs it

RFFW LLC

Same treasurer (Moore). Subject of a state complaint alleging a " $1,000,000 money laundering scheme" that only registered under Michigan Campaign Finance Act after being caught.

One compliance specialist. Five dark money operations:

RENAE MOORE (rmoore@dykema.com, 517-374-9121)
  = Dykema Senior Compliance Specialist (employer)
  = Save Detroit Jobs / Detroit Leaders (Asst Secretary)
  = Our Neighborhoods First (compliance)
  = Detroit Jobs First (compliance)

Full architecture: How To Build an OS

Branch 4: Banks

Brian Roderick Banks has 9 criminal convictions (six felony, three misdemeanor). He claims a J.D. from Michigan State University College of Law. The State Bar of Michigan returns zero results for "Brian Banks."

He is superintendent of two charter schools serving 90.9% economically disadvantaged and 99.2% Black students. His students score in the bottom 3% statewide in math.

His school boards include:

SchoolBoard ChairConflict
Purpose Charter AcademyHon. Cylenthia Miller — Wayne County 3rd Circuit JudgeJudge chairs board of school. School generates cases in her court.
MacDowell Preparatory AcademyHon. Tenisha Yancey — 36th District Court JudgeCampaign paid Banks Strategy $383.82 . Sole contribution = sole expenditure.

Both judges are on the ballot November 3, 2026 — the same day Rogers and Barrett are on the ballot.

The connection to the tree:

  1. Dykema formed SDJ
  2. SDJ elected Johnson
  3. Johnson sits on Banks' PCA board
  4. Banks' PCA board also includes Miller (judge) and Moreland (AAG)
  5. Dykema PAC gave $250 to Yancey (Banks' other school board chair)
  6. Dykema PAC gave $4,000 to Barrett (who calls volunteers "felons" while this felon runs schools)

The tree's roots reach from Capitol Hill to the elementary school classroom.

Full network: detroit.primals.eco

Same Donors, Same Day

Four candidates. One election. Same infrastructure.

CandidateRaceDykema ConnectionShared DonorsOn Ballot

Cylenthia MillerWayne 3rd CircuitPCA Board Chair (SDJ → Johnson → board)Dykema PAC ($250 to Yancey, co-board)Nov 3
Tenisha Yancey36th DistrictMacDowell Board Chair, Dykema PAC ($250)Banks Strategy ( $383.82 )Nov 3

Kenneth Griffin's money funds Rogers' super PAC AND Barrett's campaign. Stephen Schwarzman's money does the same. The same Dykema that delivers PAC money to Barrett formed the dark money vehicle that delivered a council member to Banks' school board.

It's one tree. They're all sitting in it.

The Trunk

W. Alan Wilk is a member of the National Republican Lawyers Association. He incorporates dark money vehicles for Democrats (Duggan, Benson/Carol Banks) and Republicans (Barrett, Chatfield, Snyder). The Deadline Detroit reporting:

"Wilk, a lawyer with the firm Dykema who has worked with a bevy of nonprofit fundraising organizations connected to Michigan politicians, including former Gov. Rick Snyder and former House Speaker Lee Chatfield."

Lee Chatfield was later charged with criminal sexual conduct.

Renae Moore handles compliance for all of them. She is simultaneously on Dykema's payroll AND in officer/compliance positions at multiple dark money entities. Her Dykema email (rmoore@dykema.com) and phone (517-374-9121) are public.

The tree doesn't care about party. The tree cares about access. Both parties pay. Both parties get served. The compliance specialist waters every branch with the same hose.

What the Tree Produces

First comes money.

Dunn sends $10M from Texas. Schwarzman sends $4.5M from Manhattan. Griffin sends $2.5M from Miami. Koch sends $14.2M from Wichita. McConnell sends $27.4M from D.C. Musk sends $5.8M from Austin.

Then comes power.

Rogers runs for Senate. Barrett runs for re-election. Miller runs for retention. Yancey runs for retention. All four: same day, November 3, 2026.

Then comes a charter school with convicted felons in the tower.

Banks runs two schools. Bottom 3% math. $4.28 million per year flows to his management company. The State Bar closed the UPL complaint. The AGC returned the grievance. Two letters, one day apart. Each pointing at the other office.

The tree grows. The branches spread. The roots are always Dykema.

Verify

entry.title: They Banked on Banks — Brian Roderick Banks, 9 Convictions, 2 Charter Schools, Detroit
entry.content:
They Banked on Banks

In 2014, Brian Roderick Banks ran for the Michigan State Senate. His PAC was called "Bank on Banks."

They did.

The judges banked on Brian Roderick Banks. The AG's office banked on Banks. The city council banked on Banks. DPSCD banked on Banks. And now a parent with custody rights calls (313) 767-3100 — the main line at Purpose Charter Academy — and the receptionist Giselle tells them they cannot see their child.

They banked on Banks, and parents are paying the interest.

Who Is Brian Roderick Banks?

Brian Roderick Banks (Michigan ICHAT SID 2029469K) has 9 criminal convictions — 6 felony, 3 misdemeanor — across 5 agencies and 5 courts in Michigan. He runs Purpose Charter Academy and MacDowell Preparatory Academy in Detroit. His dissertation from Walden University (Ph.D., 2022) lists a fabricated credential: "J.D., MSU Law, 2010." The State Bar of Michigan returns zero results for "Brian Banks." He has never been admitted to any bar.

Despite these 9 convictions, Brian Roderick Banks obtained a Michigan School Administrator Certificate from the Michigan Department of Education on September 2, 2022 — 3 days after the school year started. He now operates two publicly funded charter schools.

The Access Denial — August 29, 2026

DPD Report #26-0909-0176. A parent with legal custody attended Purpose Charter Academy. Brian Roderick Banks denied the parent access to their child and told Detroit Police he is "an attorney."

He is not an attorney. The State Bar of Michigan returns zero results for "Brian Banks." He has never been admitted to any bar. His 9 criminal convictions — 6 felonies — prevented bar admission.

When Brian Roderick Banks told police he was an attorney, he committed Unauthorized Practice of Law under MCL 450.681. When he used that false claim to deny a parent access to their child, he weaponized it.

The police report exists. The badge numbers exist. The parent's custody order exists.

Banks denied access anyway.

The PPO Weapon — September 2026

Read the sequence. A parent tries to see their child on August 29. Brian Roderick Banks blocks them and lies to police. Two days later the parent files complaints. Two weeks later Banks files a PPO motion — against the parent.

The same man who blocked a parent at the school door is now using the court to block them legally.

Then he flies to Washington to host a reception.

The Board That Protects Brian Roderick Banks

Call (313) 767-3100. Giselle answers. She works the front desk at Purpose Charter Academy. She is the operational layer between a parent and their child.

The board chair is a sitting judge in the same circuit court that handles PPO motions and custody matters in Wayne County.

In May 2025, Judge Aliyah Sabree was appointed to the 3rd Circuit Family Division — the division that handles custody cases. In July 2025, DPSCD authorized Purpose Charter Academy. The school opened. Parents enrolled children. And when a parent with custody tried to access their child, Brian Roderick Banks blocked them and filed a PPO.

The court that processes that PPO is the same court where the board chair sits.

The Receptions

The 2024 CBC party honored Sherry Gay-Dagnogo — the DPSCD board member who authorized Banks' charter. Banks honors the politician who authorized his school. At a party in Washington. While his school has 3% math proficiency.

The Inaugural Black Tie Gala used the school's name — Purpose Charter Academy. A school funded by public dollars. Hosting a gala. For a man with 9 convictions.

Public money in. Parents blocked out. The judge who chairs the board sits in the court that enforces the blocking. The AG employee who could investigate serves as vice chair instead. The council member who oversees the authorizer serves as secretary.

They banked on Brian Roderick Banks. Every institution that should have caught this instead invested in it.

The "Bank on Banks" PAC

In 2014, Brian Roderick Banks created a PAC called "Bank on Banks" for his State Senate run. The treasurer was Joseph Holland Jr. — a convicted drug offender (MDOC #443789, discharged May 8, 2024, "WITHOUT IMPROVEMENT").

A felon's campaign, managed by a felon, named "Bank on Banks."

The name was aspirational. Michigan banked on Banks. The charter system banked on Banks. The judiciary banked on Banks. They are still banking on Banks.

The returns are:

  • $3.4M extracted annually through a single-member LLC
  • 9 criminal convictions running two schools
  • A parent denied access to their child at the school door
  • A PPO filed against the parent who complained
  • A board chaired by a judge in the court that processes the PPO

What Parents Should Know

  1. You have rights. Michigan law guarantees custodial parents access to their children's school records (FERPA, 20 U.S.C. § 1232g) and access to their children during school hours consistent with custody orders.

  2. "I am an attorney" is not a legal barrier. Brian Roderick Banks is not an attorney. His claim has no legal force. If PCA staff deny you access, ask for the specific legal basis in writing.

  3. PPOs require evidence. A Personal Protection Order requires a showing of cause. Filing a PPO in response to a parent exercising custody rights may constitute abuse of process.

  4. Document everything. Date, time, who said what, badge numbers if police are called. The DPD report from August 29 exists because someone documented it.

  5. File complaints. DPSCD authorized this school. Michigan Department of Education oversees charter authorizers. If DPSCD does not act, MDE can suspend their authorization power under MCL 380.502.

entry.title: Tommy Boy — The Congressman Who Calls Tenant Organizers Felons While His Donors Employ Actual Felons
entry.content:
Tommy Boy

U.S. Rep. Tom Barrett (R-Charlotte) represents Michigan's 7th Congressional District. On August 13, 2026, Barrett called his Democratic opponent — a tenant organizer, water protector, and co-founder of Mid-Michigan's tenant advocacy infrastructure — a "convicted felon."

Barrett's campaign received $4,000 from Dykema Gossett Federal PAC.

Dykema Gossett incorporated a dark money entity whose president is Kenneth Daniels — a convicted federal felon who structured cash for a $21 million drug ring (DEA press release, May 12, 2014).

The word "felon" travels outward. Actual felons travel inward.

Every claim below is sourced to FEC filings, LARA entity records, IRS 990 data, court records, or published reporting.

The Quote

C-SPAN recorded it. MLive published it. Barrett said it on August 13, 2026, when asked about campaign contributions from Rep. Max Miller's PAC:

"He didn't just chain himself to a bulldozer; he tried to shut down a pipeline. He required hours of law enforcement coming in to try and release this ridiculous protest to shut down a pipeline. One of the safest ways of transporting petroleum products and other energy resources is through pipelines. I know you guys want to cover up for him and everything, but it's indisputable that he's a convicted felon."

Sources: MLive · WWMT · C-SPAN video

What Actually Happened

FactDetailSource
The protest2013 Ingham County Line 5 pipeline protest — EnbridgeCourt records
The chargeMisdemeanor trespassing + felony resisting & obstructingCourt records
The pleaGuilty — fines and probationCourt records
The expungementConviction set aside under Michigan's Clean Slate Act (MCL 780.623)Lawrence campaign, Michigan State Police policy
Legal effectRemoved from public background-check databases. Treated as though it never occurred.MCL 780.623

A 22-year-old chained himself to a bulldozer to protect Michigan's water supply from a pipeline company. He pleaded guilty. He served probation. The conviction was expunged. The law says it's gone.

Barrett says it's "indisputable."

Who Barrett's Calling a Felon

William Lawrence is not a peripheral figure in tenant advocacy. Public records document his role:

RoleOrganizationSource
Co-founderMI Rent Is Too Damn High CoalitionBallotpedia, In These Times
Co-founderMid-Michigan Tenant Resource CenterBallotpedia, Ingham County HTF records
Co-founderSunrise Movement (national)Vox, campaign website
Democratic nomineeMI-7 Congressional District (Nov 3, 2026)Ballotpedia
EndorsementsSen. Bernie Sanders, Rep. Rashida Tlaib, Michigan AFL-CIO, United Auto WorkersBallotpedia

The Tenant Resource Center of Mid Michigan — which Lawrence co-founded — has helped Mid-Michigan families avoid homelessness, trained 18 volunteer resource navigators, and made 39 referrals to Legal Services of South Central Michigan in its first year. It is funded by the Ingham County Housing Trust Fund ($400,000 housing millage + $200,000 ARPA).

When Barrett calls Lawrence a "convicted felon," he is calling the co-founder of that infrastructure a felon.

Who Funds Barrett's "Felon" Label

Dykema Gossett Federal PAC → Tom Barrett for Congress

June 16, 2026$1,000Direct ContributionFEC Schedule A, Line 11C

FEC Committee ID: C00793976 (Tom Barrett for Congress). Anyone can look this up at FEC.gov.

What Dykema Gossett Built

Dykema Gossett is not just a law firm that donated to Barrett. It is the infrastructure layer beneath Michigan's dark money ecosystem. For the full architecture: How To Build an OS →

The relevant entity for this page:

Three names in five years. Same LARA number. Same Dykema address. Same Dykema phone. Same Dykema compliance email.

Kenneth Daniels — SDJ President

FactDetailSource
Convicted federal felonStructured $19,000 connected to a $21 million drug trafficking operationDEA press release, May 12, 2014
Sentence1 year federal prisonFederal court records
Kilpatrick-era appointeeDetroit political appointee during Kwame Kilpatrick administrationPublished reporting
Current rolePresident of Dykema-incorporated dark money entityIRS 990 + LARA records

The Projection

Read this slowly:

What Barrett SaysWhat Barrett's Donors Do
Calls opponent a "convicted felon"Barrett's PAC donor (Dykema) incorporated a dark money entity
The conviction was expungedThe entity's president is Kenneth Daniels — actual convicted federal felon
For a pipeline protestDaniels structured cash for a $21 million drug ring
Michigan's Clean Slate Act says it's goneDaniels served 1 year federal prison
Barrett says it's "indisputable"Dykema files SDJ's taxes from its own office, with its own phone number

The word "felon" travels outward — toward a water protector whose record was legally erased.

Actual convicted felons travel inward — into leadership positions within Dykema-incorporated dark money vehicles that fund the congressman deploying the label.

If you chain yourself to a bulldozer to protect Michigan's water, you are a felon.

If you structure cash for a $21M drug ring but serve on a Dykema-incorporated board, you are a president.

The Amplification Machine

Barrett didn't act alone. The "convicted felon" label moved through a staged pipeline:

Stage 1: NRCC Pre-Staging

The National Republican Congressional Committee's democratfacts.org pre-staged "convicted felon" opposition research on Lawrence in 2022 — before Lawrence announced his candidacy AND before Michigan's automatic expungement provisions took effect.

When Barrett deployed the label in August 2026, the infrastructure was already built.

NRCC spokesman Zach Bannon: "Socialist felon William Lawrence is a radical far-left liberal who puts his extreme climate agenda ahead of common sense and the priorities of hardworking Michiganders." (WWMT)

Stage 2: Jason Roe ( $782,000 )

Barrett's campaign strategist Jason Roe — Principal of Roe Strategic LLC, former Michigan Republican Party Executive Director — was paid $782,000 by the Barrett campaign (FEC disbursement records, Committee C00793976).

Roe's own website boasts: "2024: Strategist for Tom Barrett's victory in Michigan's 7th Congressional District, one of the most expensive and competitive seats in the nation."

$782,000 to one consultant. The Tenant Resource Center of Mid Michigan's annual budget from the Ingham County Housing Trust Fund is $600,000.

Stage 3: Right-Wing Media Cascade

Following Barrett's remarks, right-wing outlets escalated by targeting individual Rent Is Too Damn High volunteers — publishing personal details, home addresses, and criminal histories. Coalition internal records were leaked and weaponized.

The message to any prospective volunteer with any criminal history: your past will be weaponized against the movement if you participate.

Stage 4: Chilling Effect

Specific individuals lost their capacity to volunteer with the tenant advocacy coalition as a direct result of the smear cascade. Their privacy is not disclosed here because — unlike the smear machine — this site does not publish individual humans' personal details to score political points.

The effect is measurable: fewer volunteers, reduced capacity, tenant advocacy organizations spending time defending their people instead of defending tenants.

The Other Ad

Separate from the "convicted felon" smear, Barrett's campaign published an advertisement in a Black-owned newspaper with the wrong Election Day date.

FactDetailSource
PublicationMichigan Bulletin — Black-owned, serving Lansing since 1994Michigan Bulletin
Barrett's ad"On November 6 Vote for Tom Barrett"Published ad, Oct 2, 2024
Actual Election DayNovember 5, 2024
Barrett's other adCity Pulse (predominantly white readership) — correctly listed November 5AG cease and desist letter
Barrett defenseJason Roe called it "a proofing error"CNN, NYT

Responses

Lansing NAACP President Harold A. Pope:

"This appears to be a blatant effort to misinform and confuse Black voters in Lansing." — The New Citizens Press

Michigan Legislative Black Caucus: Filed formal complaint with Ingham County Prosecuting Office alleging violation of state law.

Michigan Attorney General: Issued cease and desist to Barrett's campaign. The AG letter noted the City Pulse ad (same week, different publication) had the correct date — meaning Barrett's campaign knew the right date while the Black newspaper received the wrong one.

The same campaign strategist — Jason Roe — managed both the "convicted felon" messaging and the campaign that produced the wrong-date ad.

The Numbers

Barrett's campaign has raised $6,300,000 (FEC, through July 15, 2026), including $1.48 million from PACs.

Selected donors relevant to this analysis:

Barrett invoked Miller's ethics investigation when deploying the "convicted felon" label against Lawrence — citing "due process for Max" in the same breath as "due process for my opponent, who's a convicted felon." He believes in due process for a congressman accused of domestic violence. He does not believe in the Clean Slate Act for a pipeline protester.

What Lawrence Built While Barrett Called Him Names

While Barrett was calling Lawrence a felon, Lawrence was advocating for tenants at Sycamore Townhomes in Lansing — 350 units, 339 pink-tagged, 150 red-tagged, 60+ residents facing eviction with 30-day notice in a housing shortage.

Lawrence negotiated an extension. He fought for $3,000-$5,000 relocation assistance per family (the receiver offered $1,000). He organized press conferences. He showed up.

While Barrett was calling Lawrence a felon, the MI Rent Is Too Damn High Coalition was pushing five tenant protection ordinances to Lansing City Council:

  1. Right to repair your own property
  2. Right to legal representation in eviction proceedings
  3. Right to renew a lease when in good standing
  4. Discrimination protections for formerly incarcerated people seeking housing
  5. Protections against retaliation for tenants who organize

Read that fourth one again. Barrett calls a tenant organizer a "convicted felon" while that organizer's coalition fights for formerly incarcerated people's right to housing. Barrett's PAC donor employs an actual convicted felon in a dark money leadership role.

The label is not applied based on conviction status. It is applied based on which side you are on.

The Entity Map

The full Dykema architecture is documented in How To Build an OS. Barrett is one output node of a 30-year system:

entry.title: Ghost Witness — The Samantha Aljouny Investigation
entry.content:
Summary

An attorney submitted correspondence from a purported journalist named "Samantha Aljouny" of "Aljouny Media Consulting" as evidence in Saginaw County Circuit Court proceedings before Judge Andre Borrello.

The journalist does not appear to exist. No articles. No bylines. No LinkedIn profile. No Michigan business registration. No professional footprint of any kind. The only traceable artifact is a ProtonMail address: SAljounyMediaConsulting@proton.me.

The attorney then:

  1. Listed Aljouny as a potential witness
  2. Demanded the opposing party admit under oath that they created the identity
  3. Swore in an affidavit that he had "no connection whatsoever" to the account
  4. Pursued contempt proceedings carrying possible incarceration

A forensic investigation has produced 13 independent convergence points.

The Convergence

1. The Account — September 2023

The ProtonMail public PGP key for SAljounyMediaConsulting@proton.me carries a creation timestamp of:

September 20, 2023 at 11:26:35 UTC

  • Hex creation-time field: 650AD6EB
  • Decimal timestamp: 1695209195
  • OpenPGP fingerprint: 8D59 A462 1930 5ABE 2021 9F07 6EE0 32D8 A3A3 E6D4

Proton states it normally generates encryption keys when an account or new email address is created. This is the best technical provenance date for the Aljouny address.

No professional journalist or media consultant operating under the name "Aljouny Media Consulting" has a documentable professional presence predating or postdating September 2023 — no bylines, no press credentials, no client work product, no directory listings, no trace anywhere.

2. The Ahmad v. University of Michigan Timing

Philip L. Ellison of Outside Legal Counsel PLC represented Hassan Ahmad in Ahmad v. University of Michigan, a significant Michigan FOIA case.

The chronology:

DateEvent
September 15, 2023Opinion issued in Ahmad v. University of Michigan

What Is Proven vs. What Is Not

Documented

  • The Aljouny ProtonMail account exists/existed
  • Its PGP key was created September 20, 2023 at 11:26:35 UTC
  • That date falls within a four-day window of Ellison's Ahmad v. UM activity
  • The attorney listed Aljouny as a potential witness
  • The attorney demanded opposing counsel admit creating the identity
  • The attorney swore he had "no connection whatsoever" to the account
  • A controlled link sent only to Aljouny was opened from an iPhone/iOS/Fastly environment
  • The same endpoint visited the site before the controlled test
  • A Detroit Free Press reporter independently received Aljouny communications
  • The reporter independently suspected the attorney based on subject matter
  • The attorney's own Oct 6 court filing matches the same technical environment
  • An IC3 complaint was filed October 6, 2026 (ID: 10f80c476ef144d4a772d0b198c75a2a)

Not Yet Proven

  • Who registered the Proton account
  • Who controlled it on each date
  • Whether the attorney personally typed every Aljouny email
  • Whether someone else had access
  • Whether the Fastly/Private Relay sessions represent one physical device

Those questions require provider/account/device evidence.

The Central Question

If provider or device evidence ultimately establishes that the attorney created, controlled, participated in, or had access to the Aljouny account, the issue becomes:

Why was a journalist being accused in court of operating an identity connected to the person making the accusation?
